target-corporation.name: Target Corporation
target-corporation.description: Target Corporation is an American retail corporation and discount department store chain headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. It operates small-format and large-format retail stores and hypermarkets. Target is the eighth-largest retailer in the U.S. and is a component of the S&P 500 Index.

the-home-depot.name: The Home Depot
the-home-depot.description: The Home Depot is an American multinational home improvement retail corporation headquartered in Cobb County, Georgia. It sells tools, construction products, building materials, appliances, and services including fuel and transportation rentals. It is the largest home improvement specialty retailer in the United States.

toyota.name: Toyota
toyota.description: Toyota Motor Corporation is a Japanese multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Toyota City, Aichi. Founded in 1937 by Kiichiro Toyoda, it is the largest automobile manufacturer in the world, producing about 10 million vehicles per year.

teleperformance.name: Teleperformance
teleperformance.description: TP, formerly Teleperformance, is a French multinational business process outsourcing company founded in 1978 with headquarters in France. It provides services including debt collection, telemarketing, customer relationship management, content moderation, and communication.

the-walt-disney-company.name: The Walt Disney Company
the-walt-disney-company.description: The Walt Disney Company is an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in Burbank, California. Founded in 1923, it became a leader in animation with the 1928 release of Steamboat Willie, popularizing Mickey Mouse.

thyssenkrupp-ag.name: thyssenkrupp AG
thyssenkrupp-ag.description: ThyssenKrupp AG is a German industrial engineering and steel production company formed by the 1999 merger of Thyssen AG and Krupp. Headquartered in Duisburg and Essen, it is one of the largest steel producers worldwide. Its products include machines, industrial services, high-speed trains, elevators, shipbuilding, and naval vessels.

tyson-foods.name: Tyson Foods
tyson-foods.description: Tyson Foods, Inc. is an American multinational food industry corporation based in Springdale, Arkansas. It is the world's second-largest processor and marketer of chicken, beef, and pork. The company operates major food brands including Tyson, Jimmy Dean, and Hillshire Farm.

traton.name: Traton
traton.description: Traton SE is a subsidiary of Volkswagen Group and one of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers. It owns brands such as Scania, MAN, and Volkswagen Truck & Bus, producing light to heavy-duty trucks, vans, and buses, and offers digital services under the RIO brand.

thales-group.name: Thales Group
thales-group.description: Thales Group is a French multinational aerospace and defence corporation specializing in electronics. It designs and manufactures aerospace and military systems and operates in cybersecurity. The company is headquartered in Paris' La Défense business district.

te-connectivity.name: TE Connectivity
te-connectivity.description: TE Connectivity plc is an Irish-incorporated multinational company that designs and manufactures electrical connectors, sensors, and electronic components. Its products serve automotive, aerospace, defence, medical, energy, industrial automation, and data center industries.

tata-steel.name: Tata Steel
tata-steel.description: Tata Steel Limited is an Indian multinational steel company headquartered in Mumbai and part of the Tata Group. Established in 1907 in Jamshedpur, it was formerly known as Tata Iron and Steel Company Limited (TISCO).

tcl-technology.name: TCL Technology
tcl-technology.description: TCL Technology Group Corp. is a Chinese partially state-owned electronics company headquartered in Huizhou, Guangdong province. It develops, manufactures, and sells consumer electronics including televisions, mobile phones, and home appliances. TCL was the second-largest television manufacturer by market share in 2022 and 2023.

the-cigna-group.name: The Cigna Group
the-cigna-group.description: The Cigna Group is an American multinational managed healthcare and insurance company based in Bloomfield, Connecticut. It provides medical, dental, disability, life, and accident insurance products primarily through employers and groups.

t-bank.name: T-Bank
t-bank.description: T-Bank, formerly Tinkoff Bank, is a Russian commercial bank based in Moscow founded in 2006 by Oleg Tinkov. It operated as a neobank without branches until 2024 and is the second largest credit card provider in Russia. It is one of the world's largest digital banks by customer count.

tatneft.name: Tatneft
tatneft.description: Tatneft is a Russian vertically integrated oil and gas company headquartered in Almetyevsk, Republic of Tatarstan. It is the fifth largest oil company in Russia and was ranked 539th in the 2020 Forbes Global 2000 list.

tdk.name: TDK
tdk.description: TDK Corporation is a Japanese multinational electronics corporation that manufactures electronic components and recording and data-storage media. The company operates under the motto "Contribute to culture and industry through creativity."

takata-corporation.name: Takata Corporation
takata-corporation.description: Takata Corporation was a Japanese automotive parts company with production facilities on four continents and European headquarters in Germany. It became known for a massive recall of defective airbag inflators linked to numerous deaths and injuries. The company filed for bankruptcy in 2017 and was acquired by Key Safety Systems.

trubnaya-metallurgicheskaya-kompaniya.name: Trubnaya Metallurgicheskaya Kompaniya
trubnaya-metallurgicheskaya-kompaniya.description: TMK is a global manufacturer and supplier of steel pipes and tubular solutions for the oil and gas industry, as well as specialty products for nuclear, chemical, and construction sectors. It operates production assets in Russia, Kazakhstan, Romania, and the Czech Republic, with R&D centers in Russia. The company is based in Moscow, Russia.

toyota-boshoku.name: Toyota Boshoku
toyota-boshoku.description: Toyota Boshoku Corporation is a Japanese automotive component manufacturer and a member of the Toyota Group. The company expanded into the North American market through Toyota Boshoku America. It specializes in automotive supplier products.

technipfmc.name: TechnipFMC
technipfmc.description: TechnipFMC plc is a UK-domiciled global oil and gas company with French-American origins. It was formed by the merger of FMC Technologies and Technip, announced in 2016 and completed in 2017, providing services for the energy industry.

textron.name: Textron
textron.description: Textron Inc. is an American industrial conglomerate based in Providence, Rhode Island. Founded in 1923 as the Special Yarns Company, its subsidiaries include Bell Textron, Kautex, Textron Aviation, and Lycoming Engines.

the-cheesecake-factory.name: The Cheesecake Factory
the-cheesecake-factory.description: The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated is a United States-based restaurant chain and cheesecake distributor. It operates 370 full-service restaurants under various brands and has bakery production facilities in California and North Carolina.

the-hertz-corporation.name: The Hertz Corporation
the-hertz-corporation.description: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. is an American car rental company based in Estero, Florida. It operates the Hertz brand along with Dollar Rent A Car, Firefly Car Rental, and Thrifty Car Rental.

t-mobile-us.name: T-Mobile US
t-mobile-us.description: T-Mobile US, Inc. is an American wireless network operator headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. It is majority-owned by the German telecommunications company Deutsche Telekom and is the second largest wireless carrier in the United States.

telefonica-brasil.name: Telefônica Brasil
telefonica-brasil.description: Telefônica Brasil, trading as Vivo, is a Brazilian telecommunications group and a subsidiary of the Spanish company Telefónica. It operates in the telecommunications industry in Brazil.

tenaga-nasional.name: Tenaga Nasional
tenaga-nasional.description: Tenaga Nasional Berhad is a Malaysian multinational electricity company and the primary electric utility in Peninsular Malaysia. It serves over 10 million customers and is the largest publicly listed power company in Southeast Asia.

truist-financial.name: Truist Financial
truist-financial.description: Truist Financial Corporation is an American bank holding company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. Formed in 2019 from the merger of BB&T and SunTrust, it offers consumer, commercial, and investment banking services across 15 states and Washington, D.C.

telus-communications.name: Telus Communications
telus-communications.description: Telus Communications Inc. is a Canadian telecommunications company based in Vancouver, British Columbia. It provides a wide range of products and services including Internet, voice, entertainment, healthcare, and mobile networks. Telus is the incumbent local exchange carrier in British Columbia and Alberta.

tata-motors-passenger-vehicles.name: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles
tata-motors-passenger-vehicles.description: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited, known as Tata Cars, is an Indian multinational automobile manufacturer based in Mumbai. It was formed in 2024 after separating Tata Group's commercial and passenger vehicle segments. The company owns British car manufacturer Jaguar Land Rover and is the third largest car manufacturer in India by sales as of 2025.

tenaris.name: Tenaris
tenaris.description: Tenaris S.A., organized in Luxembourg, manufactures and supplies steel pipes and related services for the petroleum industry. It ships over 4 million tons of pipes annually with significant sales in North America, South America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe.

telkom.name: Telkom
telkom.description: Telkom is a South African telecommunications provider offering wireline and wireless services across more than 38 African countries. Headquartered in Centurion, Gauteng, it is one of the largest telecommunications companies in South Africa by annual revenue.

tietoevry.name: Tietoevry
tietoevry.description: Tieto Corporation is a Finnish IT software and service company domiciled in Espoo, Finland. It provides IT and product engineering services and has approximately 15,000 employees across 20 countries. Tieto serves customers in sectors including energy, forestry, banking, healthcare, and public sectors.

trelleborg-ab.name: Trelleborg AB
trelleborg-ab.description: Trelleborg AB is a multinational engineering company headquartered in Trelleborg, Sweden. It designs and manufactures polymer technology products including seals, hoses, and antivibration solutions. The company became public in 1964 and trades on Nasdaq Stockholm.

telecom-argentina.name: Telecom Argentina
telecom-argentina.description: Telecom Argentina S.A., operating under the brand Personal, is the major telephone company for northern Argentina including Buenos Aires. It was briefly known as Sociedad Licenciataria Norte S.A. and is commonly called Telecom within Argentina.

telekom-greece.name: Telekom (Greece)
telekom-greece.description: Hellenic Telecommunications Organization S.A., also known as Hellenic Telekom, is the largest telecommunications and IT company in Greece. It is a subsidiary of Germany-based Deutsche Telekom and one of the three largest companies listed on the Athens Stock Exchange by market capitalization.

tenneco.name: Tenneco
tenneco.description: Tenneco, Inc. is an American automotive components original equipment manufacturer and aftermarket ride control and emissions products manufacturer. It was publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange until it was taken private in November 2022. The company is headquartered in Northville Charter Township, Michigan.

ternium.name: Ternium
ternium.description: Ternium S.A. is a steel manufacturer with production centers in several countries including Argentina, Brazil, and the United States. It owns a majority interest in Brazil's Usiminas and produces flat and long steel products. The company has a significant sales presence across the Americas.

the-warehouse-group.name: The Warehouse Group
the-warehouse-group.description: The Warehouse Group is the largest retail group in New Zealand, headquartered in Auckland. Founded in 1982, it includes brands such as the Warehouse, Warehouse Stationery, and Noel Leeming.

tsinghua-tongfang-company.name: Tsinghua Tongfang Company
tsinghua-tongfang-company.description: Tsinghua Tongfang Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded state-owned enterprise headquartered in Beijing, China. Established in 1997, it operates in consumer electronics, information technology, and energy and environmental industries.

turkcell.name: Turkcell
turkcell.description: Turkcell İletişim Hizmetleri A.Ş. is the leading mobile phone operator in Turkey, headquartered in Istanbul. It operates in multiple countries and has developed the Yaani browser for mobile and desktop platforms.

tabcorp.name: Tabcorp
tabcorp.description: Tabcorp is Australia's largest gambling company and the largest provider of wagering and gaming products and services in the country. It employs over 5,000 people and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

trimble.name: Trimble
trimble.description: Trimble Inc. is an American technology company founded in 1978 and headquartered in Westminster, Colorado. It develops hardware and software for sectors including architecture, engineering, construction, surveying, mapping, and transportation logistics.

toyo-tire-corporation.name: Toyo Tire Corporation
toyo-tire-corporation.description: Toyo Tire Corporation, commonly known as Toyo Tires, is a multinational tire and rubber products company based in Itami, Japan. It owns eight factories across Asia, North America, and Europe and distributes products worldwide.

tiffany-co.name: Tiffany & Co.
tiffany-co.description: Tiffany & Co. is an American luxury jewelry and specialty design house headquartered on Fifth Avenue in Manhattan. Owned by LVMH, it is known for sterling silver and diamond jewelry sold in stores, online, and through corporate merchandising.

tim-brasil.name: TIM Brasil
tim-brasil.description: TIM Brasil Serviços e Participações S.A., known as TIM Brasil, is a Brazilian telecommunications company and subsidiary of TIM S.p.A. It provides mobile and fixed telephony services in Brazil.

tim.name: TIM
tim.description: TIM S.p.A. is an Italian multinational telecommunications company with headquarters in Rome, Milan, Bari, and Naples. It provides fixed, public and mobile telephony, as well as DSL data services.

tele2.name: Tele2
tele2.description: Tele2 AB is a Swedish provider of mobile and fixed connectivity, telephony, data network services, TV, streaming, and global Internet of Things services. It is headquartered in Kista Science City, Stockholm, and operates major mobile networks in Sweden, Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania.

the-mosaic-company.name: The Mosaic Company
the-mosaic-company.description: The Mosaic Company is an American chemical company based in Tampa, Florida. It mines phosphate and potash and collects urea used for fertilizer, operating through international distribution networks and Mosaic Fertilizantes. It is the largest U.S. producer of potash and phosphate fertilizers.

teradata.name: Teradata
teradata.description: Teradata Corporation is an American software company providing cloud database and analytics software and services. It was formed in 1979 in Brentwood, California, through a collaboration between Caltech researchers and Citibank's technology group.

tribune-media.name: Tribune Media
tribune-media.description: Tribune Media Company, formerly known as the Tribune Company, was an American multimedia conglomerate headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It operated in the media industry.

tryg.name: Tryg
tryg.description: Tryg A/S is a Scandinavian insurance company operating in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. It is the largest provider of general insurance services in the Nordic countries and is listed on Nasdaq OMX Copenhagen.

take-two-interactive.name: Take-Two Interactive
take-two-interactive.description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is an American video game holding company based in New York City. It was co-founded by Ryan Brant and Mark E. Seremet in September 1993. The company operates in the video game industry.

tegna-inc.name: Tegna Inc.
tegna-inc.description: Tegna Inc. is an American broadcast, digital media, and marketing services company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia. It operates 64 local television stations in 51 U.S. markets and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Nexstar Media Group.

tvs-motor-company.name: TVS Motor Company
tvs-motor-company.description: TVS Motor Co., Ltd. is an Indian multinational motorcycle manufacturer headquartered in Chennai. It is the third-largest motorcycle company in India by revenue and the second largest two-wheeler exporter with exports to over 60 countries.

tpg-telecom.name: TPG Telecom
tpg-telecom.description: TPG Telecom Limited is an Australian telecommunications company formed after a merger with Vodafone Hutchison Australia. It is the second-largest telecommunications company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange and the third-largest wireless carrier in Australia.

torm.name: TORM
torm.description: TORM is a Copenhagen-based Danish shipping company that owns and operates product tankers. Its vessels transport refined oil products such as gasoline, jet fuel, naphtha, and diesel oil.

treasury-wine-estates.name: Treasury Wine Estates
treasury-wine-estates.description: Treasury Wine Estates is an Australian global winemaking and distribution company headquartered in Melbourne. It was formerly the wine division of the international brewing company Foster's Group.

tc-energy.name: TC Energy
tc-energy.description: TC Energy Corporation is a Canadian energy company based in Calgary, Alberta. It builds and operates fossil fuel pipelines and energy infrastructure across Canada, the United States, and Mexico. Its core business segments include Natural Gas Pipelines, Power Generation, and Energy Storage.

teradyne.name: Teradyne
teradyne.description: Teradyne, Inc. is an American company that designs and manufactures automatic test equipment. It is headquartered in North Reading, Massachusetts, and serves high-profile customers such as Samsung, Qualcomm, Intel, and IBM. The company operates in the technology sector.

tikkurila.name: Tikkurila
tikkurila.description: Tikkurila Oyj is a Finnish manufacturer of paints and lacquers. Its main office and most production facilities are located in Kuninkaala, Vantaa near Helsinki. The company operates in the industrial manufacturing sector.

tennant-company.name: Tennant Company
tennant-company.description: The Tennant Company is a US-based provider of cleaning products headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. It employs about 4,500 people and is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

tripadvisor.name: Tripadvisor
tripadvisor.description: Tripadvisor is an American company operating online travel agencies, comparison shopping websites, and mobile apps featuring user-generated content. It serves the tourism industry by providing travel-related information and services.

taurus.name: Taurus
taurus.description: Taurus Armas S.A. is a Brazilian manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in São Leopoldo, Rio Grande do Sul. Founded in 1939, it includes a firearm division and other divisions focused on metals manufacturing, plastics, body armor, helmets, and civil construction.

transelectrica.name: Transelectrica
transelectrica.description: Transelectrica is an electricity transmission system operator in Romania. It is a publicly traded company with majority shares held by the Ministry of Economy and Commerce. The company is listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange.

telenet-group.name: Telenet group
telenet-group.description: Telenet Group N.V. is the largest cable broadband provider in Belgium, offering analog and digital cable TV, fixed and mobile telephone services primarily in Flanders and Brussels. It also serves business customers across Belgium and Luxembourg.

telecom-armenia.name: Telecom Armenia
telecom-armenia.description: Telecom Armenia OJSC is an Armenian broadband and telecommunications company headquartered in Yerevan. It operates in the telecommunications industry within Armenia.

tecan.name: Tecan
tecan.description: Tecan Group Ltd. is a Swiss company that provides laboratory instruments and solutions for biopharmaceuticals, forensics, clinical diagnostics, and medical technology. Its customers include pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, research departments, diagnostic laboratories, and clinics.

tullow-oil.name: Tullow Oil
tullow-oil.description: Tullow Oil plc is a multinational oil and gas exploration company founded in Tullow, Ireland, with headquarters in London, United Kingdom. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

teamviewer-se.name: TeamViewer SE
teamviewer-se.description: TeamViewer SE is an international technology company headquartered in Göppingen, Germany. It is known for its remote access and support software that allows customers to connect, monitor, and control devices across various industries. The company is listed on the stock exchange and is a member of SDAX and TecDAX.

tessellis.name: Tessellis
tessellis.description: Tessellis S.p.A. is an Italian telecommunications company founded in 1998 and based in Cagliari, Sardinia. It provides Internet and telecommunications services in Italy and previously operated in other European countries.

tri-pointe-group.name: TRI Pointe Group
tri-pointe-group.description: Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. is a home construction company headquartered in Incline Village, Nevada. It operates in multiple U.S. states and offers financing and insurance services to homebuyers.

trivago.name: Trivago
trivago.description: Trivago N.V. is an international technology company owned by the US-based Expedia Group specializing in travel and lodging. Its main product is the Trivago online search engine and accommodation booking website that lists prices from hotels and other booking sites.

tomy.name: Tomy
tomy.description: Tomy Company, Ltd. is a Japanese toy and entertainment company founded in 1924 by Eiichirō Tomiyama. Known for popular toys like the B-29 friction toy and Pop-up Pirate game, it merged with Takara in 2006 and is headquartered in Katsushika, Tokyo.

tobii-ab.name: Tobii AB
tobii-ab.description: Tobii AB is a Swedish technology company that develops and sells eye tracking and attention computing products. It is based in Sweden and specializes in peripheral technology.

telegate.name: Telegate
telegate.description: Telegate is a communications company based in Martinsried, Germany, providing directory assistance services in Germany, Spain, and Italy. Founded in 1996, it is publicly held and was listed on the Neuer Markt of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in 1999.

telenav.name: Telenav
telenav.description: Telenav, Inc. is a wireless location-based services company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It provides GPS navigation, local search, automotive navigation, mobile advertising, and enterprise mobility services with offices worldwide.

talvivaara-mining-company.name: Talvivaara Mining Company
talvivaara-mining-company.description: Ahtium was a Finnish mining company that operated the Talvivaara nickel mine from 2004 until the mining business was sold to the state-owned Terrafame in 2015. It was involved in the mining industry in Finland.

tomra.name: Tomra
tomra.description: TOMRA is a Norwegian multinational corporation that manufactures collection and sorting products, including reverse vending machines for recycling bottles and cans. It also produces machines for the food, recycling, and mining industries. TOMRA is a market leader with a global presence.

tungsten-network.name: Tungsten Network
tungsten-network.description: Tungsten Network is a global electronic invoicing firm providing supply chain financing services from offices in the United Kingdom, United States, Bulgaria, Germany, and Malaysia. It is traded on the London Stock Exchange.

toei-company.name: Toei Company
toei-company.description: Toei Company, Ltd. is a Japanese entertainment company headquartered in Tokyo. It is involved in film and television production, distribution, video game development, and owns 34 movie theaters. Toei is known for producing anime, live-action dramas, and is the majority shareholder of Toei Animation.

tauron-polska-energia.name: Tauron Polska Energia
tauron-polska-energia.description: Tauron Polska Energia S.A. is an energy holding company headquartered in Katowice, Poland. It owns assets in power and heat generation, distribution, and coal mining, mainly in southwestern Poland. It is the second largest energy producer in Poland.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text, formerly LiveChat Software, is a Polish software company based in Wrocław. It develops AI-based customer service and communication software for both B2B and B2C markets. The company is publicly listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

tanger-inc.name: Tanger Inc.
tanger-inc.description: Tanger Inc. is a real estate investment trust based in Greensboro, North Carolina. It invests in open air outlet and lifestyle shopping centers across the United States and Canada. The company operates in the real estate sector.

team17.name: Team17
team17.description: Team17 Digital Limited is a British video game developer and publisher based in Wakefield, England. It was formed in 1990 through the merger of 17-Bit Software and Team 7. The company is known for the Worms franchise, which remains its primary development output with over 20 entries.

tgs-nopec-geophysical-company.name: TGS-NOPEC Geophysical Company
tgs-nopec-geophysical-company.description: TGS, formerly TGS NOPEC Geophysical Company ASA, is an energy data and analytics company that gathers, interprets, and markets seismic and geophysical data worldwide to evaluate oil and gas formations. It was founded by a 1998 merger and has financial headquarters in Oslo, Norway, and operational headquarters in Houston, Texas.

tcl-electronics.name: TCL Electronics
tcl-electronics.description: TCL Electronics Holdings Limited is a Chinese multinational corporation headquartered in Hong Kong and incorporated in the Cayman Islands. It specializes in R&D, manufacturing, and distribution of televisions, mobile phones, air conditioners, washing machines, refrigerators, and smart home internet services. It is a subsidiary of TCL Industries Holdings.

taiyuan-coal-gasification-group.name: Taiyuan Coal Gasification Group
taiyuan-coal-gasification-group.description: Taiyuan Coal Gasification (Group) Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned coal mining conglomerate based in Taiyuan, Shanxi. It is managed by Jincheng Anthracite Mining Group since 2011 under Shanxi SASAC.

thoughtworks.name: ThoughtWorks
thoughtworks.description: Thoughtworks Holding, Inc. is a privately held global technology company with 49 offices in 18 countries. It provides software design, delivery, tools, and consulting services, and is linked to the Agile software development movement.

the-hershey-company.name: The Hershey Company
the-hershey-company.industry: Manufacture of cocoa, chocolate and sugar confectionery
the-hershey-company.description: The Hershey Company is an American multinational confectionery company headquartered in Hershey, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1894 by Milton S. Hershey, it is one of the largest chocolate manufacturers in the world and also produces baked goods and beverages.

thredup.name: Thredup
thredup.description: ThredUp Inc. is an American company operating an online resale platform specializing in second-hand clothing, footwear, and accessories. Founded in 2009, it is headquartered in Oakland, California, and is a leading resale fashion marketplace.

teejay-lanka.name: Teejay Lanka
teejay-lanka.description: Teejay Lanka PLC, formerly Textured Jersey Lanka, is a knitted fabric manufacturer based in Sri Lanka. It is part of the S&P Sri Lanka 20 Index and supplies fabrics to major brands including Nike and Marks & Spencer.

tokyo-cement.name: Tokyo Cement
tokyo-cement.description: Tokyo Cement Company (Lanka) PLC is a Sri Lankan cement manufacturer headquartered in Colombo. Founded in 1982 by entrepreneur A. Y. S. Gnanam, it produces Portland cement, Pozzolana cement, tile adhesives, and other cement products.

tri-counties-bank.name: Tri Counties Bank
tri-counties-bank.description: Tri Counties Bank is a financial institution headquartered in Chico, California. It is a subsidiary of TriCo Bancshares and was founded in 1975 to serve three counties in California.

trump-media-technology-group.name: Trump Media & Technology Group
trump-media-technology-group.description: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. is an American media and technology company headquartered in Sarasota, Florida. It operates the Truth Social social-media platform and is majority-owned by the Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust.

ten-fu-group.name: Ten Fu Group
ten-fu-group.description: Tenfu Tea, or Ten Fu, is a China-based company specializing in tea and tea food products. It operates within the consumer goods sector focused on tea products.

tupperware.name: Tupperware
tupperware.description: Tupperware is an American company that manufactures and distributes kitchen and home preparation, storage, and serving containers internationally. It was founded in 1942 by Earl Tupper, who introduced the first bell-shaped container to the public in 1946.

the-cooper-companies.name: The Cooper Companies
the-cooper-companies.description: The Cooper Companies, Inc., branded as CooperCompanies, is a global medical device company headquartered in San Ramon, California. It has two business units: CooperVision, which manufactures contact lenses, and CooperSurgical, which produces medical devices and fertility and genomic products for women's healthcare.

thine-electronics.name: THine Electronics
thine-electronics.description: THine Electronics Incorporated is a Japanese fabless LSI manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, with subsidiaries in Seoul and Taipei. It provides mixed signal LSIs and analog technologies, including high-speed interfaces and power management products used in smartphones, tablets, TVs, monitors, and automotive markets.

tech-mahindra-india.name: Tech Mahindra India
tech-mahindra-india.description: Tech Mahindra is an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting company. Founded in 1986 as a joint venture between Mahindra & Mahindra and BT Group, it is part of the Mahindra Group and headquartered in Pune, India.

tein.name: Tein
tein.description: TEIN, INC. is a Japanese company specializing in suspension manufacturing and sales for passenger cars and motorsports cars. It is headquartered in Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan.

tv-tokyo-holdings.name: TV Tokyo Holdings
tv-tokyo-holdings.description: The TV Tokyo Holdings Corporation is a Japanese media holding company headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It includes TV Tokyo Corporation, TV Tokyo Communications, and BS TV Tokyo, operating broadcasting and internet streaming services. The company was formed in 2010 and is partially controlled by Nikkei, Inc.

taiyo-yuden.name: Taiyo Yuden
taiyo-yuden.description: Taiyo Yuden Co., Ltd. is a Japanese materials and electronics company headquartered in Kyobashi, Tokyo. Founded in 1950, it helped pioneer recordable CD technology (CD-R) along with Sony and Philips in 1988. The company operates factories across several Asian countries including Japan, Singapore, and China.

taiyo-nippon-sanso.name: Taiyo Nippon Sanso
taiyo-nippon-sanso.description: Nippon Sanso Holdings Corporation is a holding company overseeing group companies including Taiyo Nippon Sanso, a major industrial gas manufacturer, and Thermos, a stainless steel thermos manufacturer. It is a consolidated subsidiary of the Mitsubishi Chemical Group.

tokyo-tatemono.name: Tokyo Tatemono
tokyo-tatemono.description: Tokyo Tatemono Co., Ltd. is a Japanese real estate company headquartered in Tokyo. Founded in 1896, it develops, sells, and manages commercial buildings, housing, hotels, and leisure facilities, with investments expanding into China and Southeast Asia.

tokai-kisen.name: Tōkai Kisen
tokai-kisen.description: Tōkai Kisen is a shipping company based in Minato, Tokyo, Japan. It provides freight and passenger transportation between Honshu and the Izu Islands and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

toho-gas.name: Toho Gas
toho-gas.description: Toho Gas Co., Ltd. is a Japanese gas company based in Nagoya. It supplies gas to the Tōkai region and is considered one of Nagoya's four influential companies.

torikizoku.name: Torikizoku
torikizoku.description: Torikizoku is a Japanese izakaya chain established in 1985 by Tadashi Okura. It operates 700 branches worldwide as of 2026 and is part of the Eternal Hospitality Group. The company is based in Japan and specializes in food service.

trident-microsystems.name: Trident Microsystems
trident-microsystems.description: Trident Microsystems Inc. was an American fabless semiconductor company known in the 1990s for supplying integrated circuits for video display controllers. It later focused on display processors for digital and LCD televisions.

tvb.name: TVB
tvb.description: TVB Limited is a Hong Kong television network that started broadcasting in 1967. It operates multiple free-to-air channels including TVB Jade and TVB Pearl, and is known for its television dramas and beauty pageants.

telio.name: Telio
telio.description: Telio is a Norwegian telecommunications company providing VoIP telephony services in Norway, Denmark, and the Netherlands. It is the second largest VoIP provider in Norway and also supplies GSM mobile subscriptions virtually.

ttm-technologies.name: TTM Technologies
ttm-technologies.description: TTM Technologies, Inc. is an American manufacturer of printed circuit boards headquartered in Santa Ana, California. Founded in 1998, it is one of the top five PCB manufacturers globally and the largest supplier to the U.S. military.

torrent-pharmaceuticals.name: Torrent Pharmaceuticals
torrent-pharmaceuticals.description: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Ahmedabad. It is part of the Torrent Group and was originally founded as Trinity Laboratories Ltd before being renamed.

the-howard-hughes-corporation.name: The Howard Hughes Corporation
the-howard-hughes-corporation.description: Howard Hughes Holdings Inc., formerly the Howard Hughes Corporation, is a real estate development and management company based in The Woodlands, Texas. Formed in 2010 as a spin-off from General Growth Properties, it focuses on master-planned communities and has historical ties to the original Howard Hughes Corporation.

tv-azteca.name: TV Azteca
tv-azteca.description: TV Azteca is a Mexican multimedia conglomerate owned by Grupo Salinas and is the second-largest mass media company in Mexico. It owns two national television networks, Azteca Uno and Azteca 7, and operates additional nationally distributed services including adn40 and A Más+. The company also runs a collection of pay TV networks.

tjx-companies.name: TJX Companies
tjx-companies.description: The TJX Companies, Inc. is an American multinational off-price department store corporation headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts. It was formed as a subsidiary of Zayre Corp. in 1987 and became the legal successor to Zayre Corp. after a reorganization in 1989.

transmontaigne.name: TransMontaigne
transmontaigne.description: TransMontaigne GP LLC is an oil pipeline and terminal company based in Denver, Colorado. It became a wholly owned subsidiary of Morgan Stanley in 2006 and was later sold to NGL Energy in 2014. In 2016, it was sold to ArcLight Capital Partners.

tokmanni.name: Tokmanni
tokmanni.description: Tokmanni Group Oyj is a Finnish retail chain and the largest discount store chain in Finland by net sales. It operates nearly 200 stores nationwide.

tod-s-s-p-a.name: Tod's S.p.A.
tod-s-s-p-a.description: Tod's S.p.A. is an Italian luxury fashion company specializing in footwear, leather goods, and accessories. It originated as a family shoemaking business in the late 1920s and expanded into industrial production in the 1970s. The company was publicly listed on the Borsa Italiana in 2000 until its privatization in 2024.

tianjin-port-holdings.name: Tianjin Port Holdings
tianjin-port-holdings.description: Tianjin Port Holdings Company Limited operates Tianjin Port and provides warehousing, storage, freight forwarding, and shipping brokerage services. It is parented by Tianjin Port (Group) and was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1996. The company changed its name to Tianjin Port Holdings in 1998.

tierone-bank.name: TierOne Bank
tierone-bank.description: TierOne Bank was a bank based in Lincoln, Nebraska, founded in 1907. It traded on the Nasdaq until its failure in June 2010, after which multiple executives faced charges related to the failure.

taiheiyo-cement.name: Taiheiyo Cement
taiheiyo-cement.description: Taiheiyo Cement Corporation is a Japanese cement company formed in 1998 by merging Chichibu Onoda and Nihon Cement. It operates in the cement industry in Japan.

tan-chong-motor-holdings-berhad.name: Tan Chong Motor Holdings Berhad
tan-chong-motor-holdings-berhad.description: Tan Chong Motor Holdings Berhad is a Malaysian multinational corporation involved in automobile assembly, manufacturing, distribution, and sales. Founded in 1957, it is best known as the Nissan franchise holder in Malaysia. The company was listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange in 1974.

the-wharf-holdings-limited.name: The Wharf (Holdings) Limited
the-wharf-holdings-limited.description: The Wharf (Holdings) Limited is a Hong Kong-based company founded in 1886. Originally focused on wharfage and dockside warehousing, it was initially known as The Hong Kong and Kowloon Wharf and Godown Company, Limited. The company adopted its current name in 1986 and is majorly held by Wheelock & Co.

tel-aviv-stock-exchange.name: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange
tel-aviv-stock-exchange.description: The Tel Aviv Stock Exchange is the only public stock exchange in Israel and is itself a public company listed on its own exchange since August 2019. It is regulated by the Securities Law of 1968 and supervised by the Israel Securities Authority. The exchange is colloquially known as The Bursa.

tractor-supply-company.name: Tractor Supply Company
tractor-supply-company.description: Tractor Supply Company is an American chain store founded in 1938 and based in Brentwood, Tennessee. It sells home improvement, agriculture, lawn and garden, livestock, equine, and pet care equipment and supplies. The company caters to farmers, ranchers, pet owners, and landowners.

the-saudi-national-bank.name: The Saudi National Bank
the-saudi-national-bank.description: Saudi National Bank, also known as SNB AlAhli and formerly National Commercial Bank, is the largest commercial bank in Saudi Arabia.

teleste.name: Teleste
teleste.description: Teleste Oyj is an international technology group specializing in broadband, security, and information technologies and related services. Its customers include data communications operators, train manufacturers, public transport operators, and public sector organizations.

teac-corporation.name: TEAC Corporation
teac-corporation.description: TEAC Corporation is a Japanese electronics manufacturer formed by the merger of the Tokyo Television Acoustic Company and the Tokyo Electro-Acoustic Company. It was created from companies founded in 1953 and 1956 respectively. The company is based in Japan.

triumph-group.name: Triumph Group
triumph-group.description: Triumph Group, Inc. is an American aerospace supplier based in Radnor, Pennsylvania. It engineers, designs, and manufactures aircraft components, systems, and accessories. The company operates through three organizations: Integrated Systems, Aerospace Structures, and Product Support.

tianwei-baobian-electric.name: Tianwei Baobian Electric
tianwei-baobian-electric.description: Baoding Tianwei Baobian Electric Co., Ltd. (BTW) is a Chinese manufacturer of power transformers and electrical equipment. It is one of the major transformer manufacturers in China alongside Tebian Electric Apparatus and the XD Group.

tivity-health.name: Tivity Health
tivity-health.description: Tivity Health is an administrator of fitness and wellness services headquartered in Franklin, Tennessee. Founded in 1981 as American Healthways, it rebranded in 2017 and acquired Nutrisystem Inc. in 2019 before selling the nutrition business in 2020.

taro-pharmaceuticals.name: TARO Pharmaceuticals
taro-pharmaceuticals.description: Taro Pharmaceutical Industries is an Israeli research-based pharmaceutical manufacturer. It was publicly listed on the New York Stock Exchange before being acquired by Sun Pharma. The company sells more than 180 drugs worldwide, mainly in the United States, Canada, and Israel.

tullett-prebon-europe-otf.name: Tullett Prebon Europe - OTF
tullett-prebon-europe-otf.description: TP ICAP Group plc is a financial services firm headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

telekom-malaysia.name: Telekom Malaysia
telekom-malaysia.description: Telekom Malaysia Berhad is a Malaysian telecommunications company founded in 1984. It started as the national telecommunications provider for fixed line, radio, and television broadcasting services and has grown to be the largest provider of broadband, data, fixed line, pay television, and network services in Malaysia.

the-israel-corporation-ltd.name: The Israel Corporation Ltd.
the-israel-corporation-ltd.description: Israel Corporation is Israel's largest holding company, founded in 1968 by the Government of the State of Israel.

toray-industries.name: Toray Industries
toray-industries.description: Toray Industries, Inc. is a multinational corporation headquartered in Japan specializing in industrial products based on organic synthetic chemistry, polymer chemistry, and biochemistry technologies.

td-cowen.name: TD Cowen
td-cowen.description: TD Cowen is an American multinational investment bank and financial services division of TD Securities. It operates through two business segments: a broker-dealer and an investment management division.

titanium-metals.name: Titanium Metals
titanium-metals.description: Titanium Metals Corporation (TIMET) is an American manufacturer of titanium-based metals products, primarily for the aerospace industry. Founded in 1950, it is headquartered in Warrensville Heights, Ohio, with major operations across the United States and overseas in the UK and France.

tupperware-brands.name: Tupperware Brands
tupperware-brands.description: Tupperware Brands Corporation is an American multinational company producing home products, mainly kitchen gadgets and plastic food storage containers. It is known for its line of plastic containers used for food preparation and storage.

tsinghua-holdings.name: Tsinghua Holdings
tsinghua-holdings.description: Tsinghua Holdings Corp., Ltd. is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tsinghua University in China. It was established as an in-house asset management company for Tsinghua's subsidiaries created in the 1990s through technology transfer from research to business.

teamway-international-group-holdings-lim.name: Teamway International Group Holdings Limited
teamway-international-group-holdings-lim.description: Teamway International Group Holdings Limited is a Cayman-incorporated holding company based in Hong Kong and mainland China. It is engaged in packaging product manufacturing, corporate services, and property investment.

totens-sparebank.name: Totens Sparebank
totens-sparebank.description: Totens Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Lena, Norway, with its main market in Innlandet. The bank was established in 1854 and operates in the financial services sector.

taiyuan-heavy.name: Taiyuan Heavy
taiyuan-heavy.description: Taiyuan Heavy Industry Co., Ltd. is a Chinese manufacturer of industrial machinery including construction equipment and train wheels. It is one of the largest heavy machinery makers in China and competes with CITIC Heavy Industries and China First Heavy Industries.

tesco-corporation.name: Tesco Corporation
tesco-corporation.description: Tesco Corporation was an oilfield services company headquartered in Spring Branch, Houston. It provided top drive rental services for land and offshore oil platforms and casing running services. The company was acquired by Nabors Industries in December 2017.

tech-data.name: Tech Data
tech-data.description: Tech Data Corporation was a multinational distribution company headquartered in Clearwater, Florida, specializing in IT products and services. It merged with Synnex to form TD Synnex, providing technology manufacturers and resellers with product lines, logistics, and value-added services.

tama-home.name: Tama Home
tama-home.description: TamaHome Co. Ltd., also known as TamaHome, is a Japanese housing company established in 1998. It operates in the construction industry and is part of the JPX-Nikkei Mid and Small Cap Index as of 2021. The company is based in Japan.

tim-hortons.name: Tim Hortons
tim-hortons.description: Tim Hortons Inc. is a Canadian multinational coffeehouse and restaurant chain headquartered in Toronto. It serves coffee, donuts, sandwiches, breakfast egg muffins, and other fast-food items. It is Canada's largest quick-service restaurant chain with over 6,000 restaurants across 14 countries.

toto-ltd.name: Toto Ltd.
toto-ltd.description: Toto Ltd. is a Japanese multinational manufacturer of plumbing fixtures and semiconductors, known for the Washlet product. Founded in 1917, the company is based in Kitakyushu, Japan, and has production facilities in nine countries.

the-people-s-insurance-company-group-of-.name: The People's Insurance Company (Group) of China Limited
the-people-s-insurance-company-group-of-.legal_name: The People's Insurance Company (Group) of China Limited
the-people-s-insurance-company-group-of-.description: The People's Insurance Company (Group) of China Limited, known as PICC, is a Chinese listed insurer. The Chinese Central Government is the controlling shareholder. The company operates in the insurance industry.

listings.name: The People's Insurance Company (Group) of China Limited

tokyo-gas.name: Tokyo Gas
tokyo-gas.description: Tokyo Gas Co., Ltd., founded in 1885, is the primary natural gas provider to major cities in Japan including Tokyo and Kanagawa. As of 2012, it is the largest natural gas utility in Japan.

taboola.name: Taboola
taboola.description: Taboola is a public advertising technology company headquartered in New York City. Founded in 2007, it operates a digital advertising platform that connects advertisers with audiences across publisher websites using machine learning techniques.

tandy-leather-factory.name: Tandy Leather Factory
tandy-leather-factory.description: Tandy Leather Factory, Inc. is an American specialty retailer and wholesale distributor of leather and leatherwork products. It operates over 100 stores worldwide and was originally part of the Tandy Corporation. Its flagship store in Fort Worth, Texas houses the Al and Ann Stohlman Leathercraft Museum.

the-honest-company.name: The Honest Company
the-honest-company.description: The Honest Company, Inc. is an American digital-first consumer goods company based in Los Angeles, founded by Jessica Alba and others. It serves markets including the US, China, Canada, and Europe and went public in May 2021.

tempo-beverages-ltd.name: Tempo Beverages Ltd
tempo-beverages-ltd.description: Tempo Beer Industries is Israel's largest brewer and the country's second-largest beverage company.

tradeweb-llc.name: Tradeweb Llc
tradeweb-llc.description: Tradeweb Markets Inc., headquartered in New York City, operates electronic trading platforms mainly for institutional investors trading fixed income products, ETFs, and derivatives. It serves over 3,000 customers including banks and asset managers, with revenue primarily from transaction fees and commissions.

time-warner-cable.name: Time Warner Cable
time-warner-cable.description: Time Warner Cable Enterprises LLC was an American cable television company headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. It was the second largest cable company in the United States by revenue before being acquired by Charter Communications in 2016. It operated in 29 states with additional offices in Connecticut, North Carolina, and Virginia.

tata-motors-limited.name: Tata Motors Limited
tata-motors-limited.description: Tata Motors Limited is an Indian multinational commercial vehicle manufacturer headquartered in Mumbai. It produces trucks, vans, and buses and is part of the Tata Group.

thai-airways.name: Thai Airways
thai-airways.description: Thai Airways International plc is the flag carrier airline of Thailand headquartered in Bangkok. Founded in 1961, it operates primarily from Suvarnabhumi Airport and is a founding member of the Star Alliance. It also holds a stake in Nok Air and launched the regional carrier Thai Smile, which is planned to merge back into Thai Airways.

terex.name: Terex
terex.description: Terex Corporation is an American company that manufactures materials processing machinery, waste and recycling equipment, mobile elevating work platforms, and equipment for the electric utility industry. It operates globally in the Americas, Europe, Australia, and Asia Pacific.

tt-electronics-plc.name: TT Electronics Plc
tt-electronics-plc.description: TT Electronics Plc is a global manufacturer of electronic components and provider of manufacturing services headquartered in London, England. It is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange.

tgc-1.name: TGC-1
tgc-1.description: TGC-1 is a regional power company headquartered in Saint Petersburg, Russia. It operates in North-West Russia with branches in Karelia and Kola. The company is involved in power engineering.

the-star-entertainment-group.name: The Star Entertainment Group
the-star-entertainment-group.description: The Star Entertainment Group Limited is an Australian gambling and entertainment company formerly known as Echo Entertainment. It is Australia's largest listed casino group.

takashimaya.name: Takashimaya
takashimaya.description: Takashimaya Company, Limited is a Japanese multinational corporation operating a department store chain. It sells a wide range of products including apparel and electronics, with branches in Japan and Asia.

talen-energy.name: Talen Energy
talen-energy.description: Talen Energy Corporation is an independent power producer and energy infrastructure company based in the United States. It operates in the energy industry, focusing on power production and related infrastructure.

teladoc.name: Teladoc
teladoc.description: Teladoc Health, Inc. is an American telemedicine and virtual healthcare company founded in 2002 and headquartered in New York City. Its services include telehealth, employer-sponsored health plans, mental health, chronic disease management, primary care, and AI analytics.

totvs.name: TOTVS
totvs.description: TOTVS S.A. is a Brazilian software company based in São Paulo, formed from the merger of Microsiga and Logocenter. It leads the Brazilian ERP market and has offices in the United States, Portugal, and Latin America.

tucows.name: Tucows
tucows.description: Tucows Inc. is an American–Canadian Internet services and telecommunications company headquartered in Toronto, Canada, and incorporated in Pennsylvania, USA. It operates three independent businesses: Tucows Domains, Ting Internet, and Wavelo.

thai-life-insurance.name: Thai Life Insurance
thai-life-insurance.description: Thai Life Insurance Public Co. Ltd is the first Thai insurance company, founded in 1942. It is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, and was one of the largest insurance companies in the country.

toscana-aeroporti.name: Toscana Aeroporti
toscana-aeroporti.description: Toscana Aeroporti S.p.A. is an Italian company managing Florence and Pisa International Airports. It is publicly listed on Borsa Italiana.

tandem-diabetes-care-inc.name: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc.
tandem-diabetes-care-inc.description: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. is a medical-device company headquartered in San Diego, California. It develops and markets insulin pumps, automated insulin delivery systems, and diabetes-management software, including the t:slim X2 and Tandem Mobi pumps using Control-IQ+ software with compatible continuous glucose monitors.

tose-co.name: Tose Co.
tose-co.description: Tose Co., Ltd. is a Japanese video game developer based in Kyoto. Founded in 1979, it is known for developing Nintendo's Game & Watch Gallery series and various Dragon Ball games. Tose is recognized as the largest non-publishing game developer worldwide.

the-a2-milk-company.name: The a2 Milk Company
the-a2-milk-company.description: The a2 Milk Company Limited is a New Zealand company that commercializes intellectual property related to A1 protein-free milk. It sells milk and related products such as infant formula under the a2 and a2 Milk brands and is cross-listed on the NZX and ASX.

tadano-limited.name: Tadano Limited
tadano-limited.description: Tadano Ltd. is a Japan-based manufacturer of cranes and aerial work platforms, recognized as one of the largest crane manufacturers worldwide.

techtronic-industries.name: Techtronic Industries
techtronic-industries.description: Techtronic Industries Company Limited is a Hong Kong–based multinational that designs, produces, and markets cordless power tools, outdoor power equipment, hand tools, and floor care appliances.

the-scotts-miracle-gro-company.name: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company
the-scotts-miracle-gro-company.description: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company is an American multinational headquartered in Marysville, Ohio. It manufactures and sells consumer lawn, garden, and pest control products, including the Scotts, Miracle-Gro, and Ortho brands. It also markets the herbicide Roundup in the U.S. and internationally.

top-glove.name: Top Glove
top-glove.description: Top Glove Corporation Berhad is a Malaysian manufacturer specializing in rubber gloves, face masks, dental dams, and other products. It operates 50 manufacturing facilities across Malaysia, Thailand, China, and Vietnam, with marketing offices in multiple countries including the US and Germany.

transalta-corporation.name: TransAlta Corporation
transalta-corporation.description: TransAlta Corporation is a Canadian electricity power generator and wholesale marketing company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. It operates 76 power plants across Canada, the US, and Australia, including wind, hydro, natural gas, and coal facilities.

trina-solar.name: Trina Solar
trina-solar.description: Trina Solar Co., Ltd., stylized as Trinasolar, is a Chinese photovoltaics company founded in 1997. It specializes in solar energy products and solutions. The company is based in China.

toast-inc.name: Toast, Inc.
toast-inc.description: Toast, Inc. is an American cloud-based restaurant management software company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It provides an all-in-one point of sale system built on the Android operating system.

transphorm.name: Transphorm
transphorm.description: Transphorm, Inc. is an American semiconductor company specializing in transistors made from gallium nitride for switched-mode power supplies. The company was acquired by Renesas Electronics in 2024. It focuses on power electronics technology.

tabio.name: Tabio
tabio.description: Tabio is a Japanese manufacturer and retailer specializing in socks, stockings, and tights. It operates in the consumer goods and retail industry.

the-new-york-times-company.name: The New York Times Company
the-new-york-times-company.description: The New York Times Company is an American mass media corporation that publishes The New York Times and its associated publications, including the International Edition. Its headquarters are located in the New York Times Building in Manhattan, New York City.

turk-telekom.name: Türk Telekom
turk-telekom.description: Türk Telekomünikasyon A.Ş., known as Türk Telekom, is a state-controlled Turkish telecommunications company headquartered in Ankara. It was separated from the Turkish Post in 1995 and offers fixed-line telephony, broadband internet, mobile services, digital television, and IT solutions across Turkey.

tiv-taam-holdings-1-ltd.name: Tiv Taam Holdings 1 Ltd
tiv-taam-holdings-1-ltd.description: Tiv Ta'am is an Israeli supermarket chain known for selling pork and other non-kosher products. It operates over 40 branches throughout Israel, some open 24/7, and is involved in food processing and formerly telecommunications.

terra-santa.name: Terra Santa
terra-santa.description: Terra Santa Agro is a publicly traded Brazilian agribusiness company focused on producing soybean, corn, and cotton. It operates seven production units in Mato Grosso and manages approximately 156.6 thousand hectares of land.

the-one-enterprise.name: The One Enterprise
the-one-enterprise.description: The One Enterprise Public Company Limited is a Thai holding company under GMM Grammy Public Company Limited. It engages in integrated entertainment media business including content creation, distribution, event organization, and artist management. Its subsidiary One31 operates as a licensed digital terrestrial television operator.

tmx-group.name: TMX Group
tmx-group.description: TMX Group Limited is a Canadian financial services company operating equities, fixed income, derivatives, and energy market exchanges. It offers services including listings, trading, clearing, settling, depository facilities, information, and technology services for the international financial community.

tva-group.name: TVA Group
tva-group.description: Groupe TVA Inc. is a Canadian communications company involved in broadcasting, publishing, and production. Founded in 1960 as Télé-Métropole Corporation, it owned Montreal's first privately owned francophone station. Quebecor Media holds voting control through near-complete ownership of Class A shares.

tsingtao-brewery.name: Tsingtao Brewery
tsingtao-brewery.description: Tsingtao Brewery Co. Ltd. is China's second largest brewery headquartered in Qingdao. It holds about 15% of the domestic market share and accounts for half of China's national beer exports.

taisei-corporation.name: Taisei Corporation
taisei-corporation.description: Taisei Corporation is a Japanese company founded in 1873 that specializes in building construction, civil engineering, and real estate development. Its headquarters are located in the Shinjuku Center Building in Tokyo. It is one of the longstanding construction firms in Japan.

tarkett.name: Tarkett
tarkett.description: Tarkett S.A. is a French multinational company specializing in floor and wall coverings. Headquartered near Paris, it was formed in 1997 by merging French Sommer-Allibert and German Tarkett AG. The company’s name originates from a product developed by a Swedish predecessor.

transcend-information.name: Transcend Information
transcend-information.description: Transcend Information, Inc. is a Taiwanese manufacturer of memory and storage products headquartered in Taipei. Founded in 1989, it develops, manufactures, and markets memory modules, flash memory, and storage devices for consumer, embedded, and enterprise applications.

true-corporation.name: True Corporation
true-corporation.description: True Corporation Public Company Limited is a communications conglomerate in Thailand formed by the merger of True Corporation and Dtac. It operates fixed-line, wireless, satellite, cable TV, IPTV, and broadband services. True controls Thailand's largest cable TV provider and internet service provider.

tokyo-electric-power-company-holdings.name: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings
tokyo-electric-power-company-holdings.description: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings is a Japanese electric utility holding company headquartered in Tokyo. It services the Kantō region, Yamanashi Prefecture, and eastern Shizuoka Prefecture, including Tokyo. The company is a founding member of several energy innovation and research consortiums.

ts-financial-holdings.name: TS Financial Holdings
ts-financial-holdings.description: Taishin Financial is a financial services company headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. Its holdings include subsidiaries in banking, securities, bills finance, asset management, and venture capital.

t-rowe-price.name: T. Rowe Price
t-rowe-price.description: T. Rowe Price Group, Inc. is an American global investment management firm headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland. It offers mutual funds, subadvisory services, and retirement plans to individuals and institutions worldwide. The firm operates with multiple international offices and serves clients in 55 countries.

talktalk-group.name: TalkTalk Group
talktalk-group.description: TalkTalk Telecom Group Limited is a British telecommunications company headquartered in Salford. It provides broadband internet, fixed line, and pay television services to consumers in the United Kingdom. The company was founded in 2003 and became standalone in 2010.

tenet-healthcare.name: Tenet Healthcare
tenet-healthcare.description: Tenet Healthcare Corporation is a for-profit multinational healthcare services company based in Dallas, Texas. It operates around 65 hospitals and over 450 healthcare facilities through various brands and partnerships. The company also provides healthcare support services via Conifer Health Solutions.

terumo.name: Terumo
terumo.description: Terumo Corporation is a Japanese medical device company founded in 1921 as Red Line Thermometer Corporation. It was established by medical scientists led by Dr. Kitasato Shibasaburō to produce medical thermometers. The company is based in Japan.

the-children-s-place.name: The Children's Place
the-children-s-place.description: The Children's Place Inc. is an American retailer of children's clothing headquartered in Secaucus, New Jersey. It operates about 525 stores in the U.S., Canada, and Puerto Rico, and sells products through online outlets and franchise partners in 15 countries. Its brands include The Children's Place and Gymboree.

the-adecco-group.name: The Adecco Group
the-adecco-group.description: The Adecco Group is a Swiss–French human resources and temporary staffing company based in Zürich, Switzerland. It is the world's second largest provider in its sector and is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

towerstream.name: Towerstream
towerstream.description: Towerstream Corporation is a fixed wireless fiber alternative company headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island. It delivers high-speed internet access to businesses in 12 urban markets across the United States and launched its On-Net fixed-wireless service in 2014.

towers-watson.name: Towers Watson
towers-watson.description: Towers Watson & Co. was a global professional services firm providing risk management, human resource consulting, actuarial services, and investment management. It operated in 37 countries and served a majority of Fortune Global 500 and Fortune 1000 companies.

tohokushinsha-film.name: Tohokushinsha Film
tohokushinsha-film.description: Tohokushinsha Film Corporation is a Japanese film distributor, production company, and dubbing studio based in Akasaka, Minato, Tokyo. Founded in 1961 by Banjirō Uemura as a dubbing house for foreign films, the Uemura family remains its largest shareholders.

tower-international.name: Tower International
tower-international.description: Tower International is a U.S.-based manufacturer of automotive structural metal components and assemblies. It primarily serves original equipment manufacturers by supplying body-structure stampings, frame and chassis structures, and complex welded assemblies for various types of vehicles.

tronox.name: Tronox
tronox.description: Tronox Limited is an American chemical company involved in the titanium products industry. It operates worldwide, mining titanium-bearing mineral sands and producing titanium dioxide pigment, pig iron, and other minerals, including rare earth-bearing monazite.

the-farm-51.name: The Farm 51
the-farm-51.description: The Farm 51 is a Polish video game developer founded in 2005. It is known for creating games such as Get Even and Chernobylite.

thunder-power.name: Thunder Power
thunder-power.description: Thunder Power is a Taiwanese automobile manufacturer specializing in electric vehicles. It focuses on electromobility solutions.

takamatsu-construction-group.name: Takamatsu Construction Group
takamatsu-construction-group.description: Takamatsu Construction Group Co., Ltd. is a conglomerate of construction and civil engineering companies headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Its subsidiaries specialize in architecture for high-rise buildings, health and welfare facilities, shrines, temples, and public civil engineering projects like airports and railways.

twist-bioscience.name: Twist Bioscience
twist-bioscience.description: Twist Bioscience is a biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, USA. Founded in 2013, it manufactures synthetic DNA and DNA products for various industries. The company is publicly traded and focuses on synthetic biology.

telebras.name: Telebras
telebras.description: Telebras is a Brazilian telecommunications company that was formerly a state-owned monopoly. It was broken up in 1998 and re-established in 2010 to manage a nationwide broadband plan and provide infrastructure and support networks for telecommunications services across Brazil.

timken-company.name: Timken Company
timken-company.description: The Timken Company is a global manufacturer of engineered bearings and industrial motion products. Headquartered in North Canton, Ohio, it operates in 45 countries worldwide.

triquint-semiconductor.name: TriQuint Semiconductor
triquint-semiconductor.description: TriQuint Semiconductor was a semiconductor company founded in 1985 in Beaverton, Oregon, later moving to Hillsboro, Oregon. It designed, manufactured, and supplied high-performance RF modules, components, and foundry services. In 2015, it merged with RF Micro Devices to form Qorvo, Inc.

transsion-holdings.name: Transsion Holdings
transsion-holdings.description: Transsion is a Chinese mobile phone manufacturer based in Shenzhen. It was the largest smartphone manufacturer by sales in Africa in 2017 and sells phones in multiple regions including the Middle East and Southeast Asia. Its brands include itel, TECNO, and Infinix.

tiso-blackstar-group.name: Tiso Blackstar Group
tiso-blackstar-group.description: Arena Holdings, formerly known as Tiso Blackstar Group, is a South African media company headquartered in Johannesburg. It publishes major South African newspapers including the Sunday Times and Business Day. The company adopted its current name in 2019 after acquisition by Lebashe Investment Group.

tyler-technologies.name: Tyler Technologies
tyler-technologies.description: Tyler Technologies, Inc. is a technology company based in Plano, Texas, that provides proprietary software to the U.S. public sector. It has offices in 17 U.S. states and one in Toronto, Canada.

trip-com-group.name: Trip.com Group
trip-com-group.description: Trip.com Group Limited is a multinational travel agency headquartered in Shanghai, China. It was the largest online travel service in the world in 2017.

tbc.name: TBC
tbc.description: The Taegu Broadcasting Corporation is a regional television and radio broadcasting company based in Daegu, South Korea. It operates as an affiliate of Seoul Broadcasting System and began official broadcasts in 1995, with FM broadcasts starting in 1997.

teledyne-e2v.name: Teledyne e2v
teledyne-e2v.description: Teledyne e2v is a UK-based manufacturer that designs and produces systems and components for healthcare, life sciences, space, transportation, defence, security, and industrial markets. Formerly known as English Electric Valve Company, it was acquired by US company Teledyne Technologies in 2017.

teledyne-flir.name: Teledyne FLIR
teledyne-flir.description: Teledyne FLIR LLC, formerly FLIR Systems Inc., is a United States-based company specializing in the design and production of thermal imaging cameras and sensors. It became a subsidiary of Teledyne Technologies in January 2021. The company serves mainly government customers, with about 31% of its 2020 revenues coming from the U.S. federal government and its agencies.

thai-rung-union-car.name: Thai Rung Union Car
thai-rung-union-car.description: Thai Rung Union Car, formerly Thai Motor Corporation, is the first Thai-based automobile manufacturer established in 1967. It assembles vehicles under various brands including Leyland, Isuzu, Toyota, Nissan, Chevrolet, and its own brand.

the-green-organic-dutchman.name: The Green Organic Dutchman
the-green-organic-dutchman.description: BZAM Ltd., formerly The Green Organic Dutchman Holdings Ltd., is a Canadian recreational cannabis company headquartered in Mississauga, Ontario. It completed the largest cannabis industry IPO on the Toronto Stock Exchange in 2018. Its stock was suspended and delisted from Canadian exchanges in 2024.

texas-capital-bank.name: Texas Capital Bank
texas-capital-bank.description: Texas Capital Bank is a bank headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It operates branches in every major city in Texas and has an online-only banking division called Bask Bank. Its parent company is Texas Capital Bancshares.

tenable-network-security.name: Tenable Network Security
tenable-network-security.description: Tenable Holdings, Inc. is a cybersecurity company based in Columbia, Maryland. It developed the Nessus vulnerability scanner software in 1998, widely used in the cybersecurity industry. As of the end of 2023, it served approximately 44,000 customers including 65% of the Fortune 500.

tencent-music.name: Tencent Music
tencent-music.description: Tencent Music Entertainment Group develops music streaming services for the Chinese market. Its apps include QQ Music, KuGou, Kuwo, and WeSing, with over 800 million active users. As of 2016, its services held an estimated 56% market share in China.

tui-group.name: TUI Group
tui-group.description: TUI AG is a German multinational company specializing in leisure, travel, and tourism. It is the largest company in its industry worldwide and is headquartered in Hanover, Germany. The company was formerly known as Preussag AG until 1997 when it shifted its focus from mining to tourism.

the-bank-of-new-york-mellon.name: The Bank of New York Mellon
the-bank-of-new-york-mellon.legal_name: The Bank of New York Mellon
the-bank-of-new-york-mellon.description: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation, known as BNY Mellon, is an American international financial services company headquartered in New York City. It provides a range of financial services globally. The company is a major player in the banking sector.

listings.name: The Bank of New York Mellon

tilray.name: Tilray
tilray.description: Tilray Brands, Inc. is an American pharmaceutical, cannabis-lifestyle, and consumer packaged goods company headquartered in New York City. It operates in Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Latin America, and has growing facilities in Germany, Portugal, and the United Kingdom.

tbs-holdings-inc.name: TBS Holdings Inc.
tbs-holdings-inc.description: TBS Holdings, Inc. is a privately owned media company in Japan. It owns TBS Television and TBS Radio networks and operates the Japan News Network with 28 affiliates and the Japan Radio Network with 34 affiliates.

trade-desk.name: Trade Desk
trade-desk.description: The Trade Desk, Inc. is a multinational technology company headquartered in Ventura, California. It produces programmatic marketing automation software and operates as the largest independent demand-side platform globally. The company works with over 400 partners across more than 30 locations worldwide.

the-michaels-companies.name: The Michaels Companies
the-michaels-companies.description: The Michaels Companies, Inc. is an American retail holding company headquartered in Irving, Texas. It operates the flagship brand Michaels and Artistree, a manufacturer of custom and specialty framing merchandise. The company was formed in 2014 and runs over 1,252 arts and crafts stores in the US and Canada.

ten-square-games.name: Ten Square Games
ten-square-games.description: Ten Square Games is a Polish mobile game developer headquartered in Wrocław with additional studios in Warsaw, Berlin, Bucharest, and Verona. The company focuses on hobby games using a pay-to-win model and has released over 200 games since 2011, including Let's Fish and Fishing Clash.

taichung-commercial-bank.name: Taichung Commercial Bank
taichung-commercial-bank.description: Taichung Commercial Bank, officially Taichung Bank, is a public bank headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan. It operates in the banking sector within Taiwan.

the-l-s-starrett-company.name: The L. S. Starrett Company
the-l-s-starrett-company.description: The L. S. Starrett Company is an American manufacturer of precision tools and instruments used by machinists, tool and die makers, and the construction industry. It produces around 5,000 variations of tools, gauges, measuring instruments, and saw blades as of 2025.

the-realreal.name: The RealReal
the-realreal.description: The RealReal, Inc. is an online marketplace headquartered in San Francisco that allows users to buy and sell authenticated luxury goods. Founded in 2011 by Julie Wainwright, the platform specializes in recommerce of high-end items.

thai-president-foods.name: Thai President Foods
thai-president-foods.description: Thai President Foods PCL is a Bangkok-based company established in 1972 that manufactures the internationally marketed instant noodle brand "MAMA." It is the largest instant noodle manufacturer in Thailand with over 50% market share as of 2020.

thai-oil.name: Thai Oil
thai-oil.description: Thai Oil Public Company Limited, also known as Thaioil, is a Thai public company and subsidiary of PTT Group. Founded in 1961 as Oil Refinery, Ltd., it is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

temenos-group.name: Temenos Group
temenos-group.description: Temenos AG is a Swiss technology company specializing in enterprise software for banks and financial services. Founded in 1993, it is headquartered in Geneva and has been listed on the Swiss stock exchange since 2001.

the-navigator-company.name: The Navigator Company
the-navigator-company.description: The Navigator Company is a Portuguese pulp and paper company. It operates in the pulp and paper industry and is based in Portugal.

transocean.name: Transocean
transocean.description: Transocean Ltd. is a Swiss offshore drilling company and the world's largest offshore drilling contractor by revenue. It has offices in 20 countries including Canada, the United States, and Brazil.

teck-resources.name: Teck Resources
teck-resources.description: Teck Resources Limited is a diversified natural resources company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. It engages in mining and mineral development including coal, copper, zinc, and energy products.

the-swatch-group.name: The Swatch Group
the-swatch-group.description: The Swatch Group Ltd is a Swiss manufacturer of watches and jewellery. Founded in 1983 through the merger of ASUAG and SSIH, it focused on manufacturing quartz-crystal watches to address the quartz crisis in the Swiss watchmaking industry.

trend-micro.name: Trend Micro
trend-micro.description: Trend Micro Inc. is an American-Japanese cybersecurity software company with R&D locations worldwide. It develops enterprise security software for servers, containers, cloud environments, networks, and endpoints, supporting major cloud platforms.

tang-eng-iron-works.name: Tang Eng Iron Works
tang-eng-iron-works.description: Tang Eng Iron Works is a steelmaking company headquartered in Siaogang District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan. It operates in the iron and steel industry.

tatung-company.name: Tatung Company
tatung-company.description: Tatung Company is a Taiwanese multinational corporation established in 1918. It is headquartered in Zhongshan, Taipei, Taiwan. The company operates in the computer hardware industry.

txnm-energy.name: TXNM Energy
txnm-energy.description: TXNM Energy, Inc. is an energy holding company based in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Founded in 1917 as Albuquerque Gas and Electric Company, it owns PNM and Texas-New Mexico Power. In 2025, Blackstone Inc.'s infrastructure business agreed to acquire the company.

toyota-tsusho.name: Toyota Tsusho
toyota-tsusho.description: Toyota Tsusho Corporation is a sōgō shōsha and member of the Toyota Group based in Nagoya and Tokyo, Japan. It supports Toyota's automobile business and operates globally with over 150 offices and 900 subsidiaries. Its business spans industrial raw materials, agricultural products, and high technology.

taylor-wimpey.name: Taylor Wimpey
taylor-wimpey.description: Taylor Wimpey plc is a home construction company in the United Kingdom formed by the merger of Taylor Woodrow and George Wimpey in 2007. It is headquartered in High Wycombe, England, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

the-hong-kong-and-china-gas-company-limi.name: The Hong Kong and China Gas Company Limited
the-hong-kong-and-china-gas-company-limi.legal_name: The Hong Kong and China Gas Company Limited
the-hong-kong-and-china-gas-company-limi.description: The Hong Kong and China Gas Company Limited, trading as Towngas, is the sole provider of territory-wide town gas in Hong Kong. Founded in 1862, it is one of the oldest listed companies in the region. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

listings.name: The Hong Kong and China Gas Company Limited

terravia.name: TerraVia
terravia.description: TerraVia Holdings, Inc. was a biotechnology company in the United States that used proprietary technology to convert plant-based sugars into high-value oils and algae ingredients. It supplied sustainable algae-based food ingredients to various brands and sold its own culinary algae oil under the Thrive Algae Oil brand. The company declared bankruptcy in 2017.

the-shyft-group.name: The Shyft Group
the-shyft-group.description: The Shyft Group is an American automobile design company that designs, engineers, and manufactures specialty chassis, vehicles, truck bodies, and aftermarket parts. Its products serve the recreational vehicle, government services, and delivery and service markets.

t4f-time-for-fun.name: T4F - Time For Fun
t4f-time-for-fun.description: T4F – Time For Fun is a Brazilian entertainment company operating in concerts, theaters, art events, family, and football sectors across Brazil, Argentina, and Chile. It is one of the largest live entertainment companies in Latin America and the world.

tanla.name: TANLA
