tanla.description: Tanla Platforms Ltd is an Indian multinational communications platform as a service company based in Hyderabad. It provides value-added cloud communication services and has offices in Singapore and Dubai. The company is listed on Indian stock exchanges BSE and NSE.

tat-technologies-ltd.name: Tat Technologies Ltd
tat-technologies-ltd.description: TAT Technologies Ltd. is a publicly traded company headquartered in the United States. It provides environmental control products and services for the commercial and military aviation industries. The company’s shares are traded on the NASDAQ Capital Market and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

tcf-financial-corporation.name: TCF Financial Corporation
tcf-financial-corporation.description: TCF Financial Corporation was an American national bank based in Wayzata, Minnesota. It operated as a holding company until 2019, when it was acquired by Chemical Financial Corporation, which then adopted the TCF name.

td-ameritrade.name: TD Ameritrade
td-ameritrade.description: TD Ameritrade Holding Corporation was a stockbroker in the United States offering an electronic trading platform for financial assets. The company was acquired by Charles Schwab Corporation in 2020.

tpi-polene.name: TPI Polene
tpi-polene.description: TPI Polene Public Company Limited is Thailand's third largest cement manufacturer. The company also produces petrochemicals such as low-density polyethylene and ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer.

takara-holdings.name: Takara Holdings
takara-holdings.description: Takara Holdings is a Japanese company based in Kyoto. It is involved in the production of beverages, food, printing, and medical supplies.

targanta-therapeutics-corporation.name: Targanta Therapeutics Corporation
targanta-therapeutics-corporation.description: Targanta Therapeutics Corporation was a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with operations in Indianapolis, Montreal, and Toronto. It completed its initial public offering in 2007 and was acquired by The Medicines Company in 2009.

tassal.name: Tassal
tassal.description: Tassal is a Canadian-owned aquaculture company with main operations in Tasmania. Founded in 1986, it was the largest producer of Tasmanian grown Atlantic salmon and was acquired by Canadian seafood company Cooke Inc. in 2022.

taylor-morrison.name: Taylor Morrison
taylor-morrison.description: Taylor Morrison Home Corporation is a large home building company in the United States headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. Formed in 2007 by the merger of Taylor Woodrow and Morrison Homes, it operates in twelve states building homes for sale and rent, including resort-style and build-to-rent communities.

techtarget.name: TechTarget
techtarget.description: TechTarget, Inc. is an American company that provides data-driven marketing services to business-to-business technology vendors.

tecumseh-products.name: Tecumseh Products
tecumseh-products.description: Tecumseh Products Company is an American manufacturer of hermetic compressors for air conditioning and refrigeration products. Its corporate offices are located in Ann Arbor, Michigan.

tejon-ranch.name: Tejon Ranch
tejon-ranch.description: Tejon Ranch Company is based in Lebec, California, and is one of the largest private landowners in California. Incorporated in 1936, it consolidated ownership of a large tract of land acquired from four Mexican land grants dating back to the 1850s and 1860s.

ttec.name: TTEC
ttec.description: TTEC Holdings, Inc. is an American customer experience technology and services company headquartered in Austin, Texas.

telecom-plus.name: Telecom Plus
telecom-plus.description: Telecom Plus plc is a British multi-utility supplier offering gas, electricity, home insurance, and telecommunications services including landline, broadband, and mobile to residences and businesses. It operates under the consumer brand Utility Warehouse and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

teledyne-technologies.name: Teledyne Technologies
teledyne-technologies.description: Teledyne Technologies Incorporated is an American industrial conglomerate founded in 1960 by Henry Singleton and George Kozmetsky. The company operates in various industrial sectors and is based in the United States.

teleflex.name: Teleflex
teleflex.description: Teleflex Incorporated is an American medical device manufacturer headquartered in Wayne, Pennsylvania. It provides specialty medical devices for critical care and surgery, operates in 40 countries, and has undergone significant realignment to focus on its medical-device business.

telephone-and-data-systems.name: Telephone and Data Systems
telephone-and-data-systems.description: Telephone and Data Systems, Inc. is an American telecommunications service company offering broadband, cable, telephone, wireless services, and radio tower leasing through subsidiaries including TDS Telecom and Array Digital Infrastructure.

telesystems-international-wireless.name: Telesystems International Wireless
telesystems-international-wireless.description: Telesystem International Wireless was a Canadian holding company with global investments in mobile communications operators. Its shares were listed on the Montreal Exchange, Toronto Stock Exchange, and NASDAQ.

telos.name: Telos
telos.description: Telos Corporation is an information technology and cybersecurity company based in Ashburn, Virginia. It primarily serves government and enterprise clients, including military, intelligence, and civilian agencies of the U.S. government and NATO allies.

telus-digital.name: Telus Digital
telus-digital.description: Telus Digital is a Canadian business process outsourcing and technology company, subsidiary of Telus Corporation. It provides services in customer experience management, digital solutions, artificial intelligence, data, and trust, safety, and security.

tetra-tech.name: Tetra Tech
tetra-tech.description: Tetra Tech, Inc. is an American consulting and engineering services firm based in Pasadena, California. It provides services in water, environment, infrastructure, resource management, energy, and international development.

texas-pacific-land-trust.name: Texas Pacific Land Trust
texas-pacific-land-trust.description: The Texas Pacific Land Corporation is a publicly traded real estate operating company based in Dallas, Texas. It owns over 880,000 acres in 20 West Texas counties and is one of the largest private landowners in Texas.

texas-roadhouse.name: Texas Roadhouse
texas-roadhouse.description: Texas Roadhouse is an American steakhouse chain specializing in Texan and Southwestern style steaks. It is a subsidiary of Texas Roadhouse Inc and is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky. The chain operates over 800 locations, including domestic and international sites.

thai-rubber-latex-group-plc.name: Thai Rubber Latex Group PLC.
thai-rubber-latex-group-plc.description: Thai Rubber Latex Group is a manufacturer and exporter based in Thailand. The company produces latex concentrate, disposable rubber gloves, extruded rubber thread, talcum coated rubber thread, and various rubber products.

thai-union-group.name: Thai Union Group
thai-union-group.description: Thai Union Group PCL is a Thailand-based producer of seafood products. Founded in 1977, it was listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand in 1994.

thestreet.name: TheStreet
thestreet.description: TheStreet is a financial news and literacy website based in the United States. It is a subsidiary of The Arena Group and offers free content as well as subscription services like TheStreet Pro, a stock recommendation portfolio.

the-andersons.name: The Andersons
the-andersons.description: The Andersons, Inc. is an American agribusiness headquartered in Maumee, Ohio. Established in 1947, it operates in commodity merchandising, renewables, and plant nutrient sectors.

the-bon-ton.name: The Bon-Ton
the-bon-ton.description: Bonton Holdings Inc., operating as Bonton, is an American former department store chain founded in 1898. The name is now used for an e-commerce website.

the-container-store.name: The Container Store
the-container-store.description: The Container Store Group, Inc. was an American specialty retail chain offering storage and organization products and custom closets. It was acquired by Bed Bath & Beyond, Inc. in 2026 with plans to rebrand its locations.

the-fresh-market.name: The Fresh Market
the-fresh-market.description: The Fresh Market, Inc. is an American supermarket chain headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina. It operates retail stores offering a variety of grocery products. The company is known for its supermarket operations in the United States.

thg.name: THG
thg.description: THG plc, originally The Hut Group, is a global retailer and brand owner headquartered in Manchester, England. It operates mainly online consumer businesses including THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. In 2025, it demerged its technology and logistics arm, THG Ingenuity, into a separate business.

the-j-m-smucker-company.name: The J.M. Smucker Company
the-j-m-smucker-company.description: The J.M. Smucker Company is an American food and beverage manufacturer headquartered in Orrville, Ohio. Founded in 1897, it produces consumer foods, pet foods, and coffee. Its flagship brand, Smucker's, is known for fruit preserves, peanut butter, and syrups.

the-pantry.name: The Pantry
the-pantry.description: The Pantry, Inc. was a publicly traded convenience store chain based in Cary, North Carolina. Founded in 1967, it operated Kangaroo Express stores and was publicly traded since 1999. The company had several CEOs including Edwin J. Holman and Dennis Hatchell.

the-rouse-company.name: The Rouse Company
the-rouse-company.description: The Rouse Company was a publicly traded shopping mall and community developer in the United States from 1954 until 2004. It was founded in 1939 by Hunter Moss and James Rouse and was acquired by General Growth Properties in 2004.

the-vitamin-shoppe.name: The Vitamin Shoppe
the-vitamin-shoppe.description: The Vitamin Shoppe is a New Jersey-based American retailer specializing in nutritional supplements. It operated stores in Canada under the name VitaPath from 2013 to 2016. The company focuses on health and wellness products.

thompson-creek-metals.name: Thompson Creek Metals
thompson-creek-metals.description: Thompson Creek Metals Company Inc. was a mining company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It produced copper, gold, and molybdenum, with principal operations including the Mount Milligan mine in British Columbia, Canada. The company owned several mining properties and development projects in North America.

thor-industries.name: Thor Industries
thor-industries.description: Thor Industries, Inc. is an American manufacturer of recreational vehicles headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana. It sells towable and motorized RVs through subsidiaries such as Airstream and Jayco. The company has manufacturing facilities across several U.S. states.

tiangong-international.name: Tiangong International
tiangong-international.description: Tiangong International Limited is a Chinese company headquartered in Danyang, Jiangsu Province. It produces and sells specialty steel materials, including high-speed steel, die steel, cutting tools, and titanium alloys. Founded in 1984, it is publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

tianjin-development.name: Tianjin Development
tianjin-development.description: Tianjin Development Holdings Limited is a Chinese conglomerate based in Tianjin. It operates in container terminal operations, toll roads, water supply, electric utilities, pharmaceuticals, and property development. In 2005, it spun off Tianjin Port Development for separate listing.

tianjin-port-development.name: Tianjin Port Development
tianjin-port-development.description: Tianjin Port Development Holdings Limited provides port services at Tianjin Port, including container stacking, warehousing, and stevedoring. It is a subsidiary of Tianjin Development and focuses on port operations in China.

tianjin-teda-co-ltd.name: Tianjin TEDA Co., Ltd.
tianjin-teda-co-ltd.description: Tianjin TEDA Co., Ltd. is a Chinese conglomerate based in Tianjin engaged in diverse businesses such as garments, ecological products, transportation, medicines, and nutrition products. It operates across multiple sectors within China.

tillys.name: Tillys
tillys.description: Tillys is an American retail clothing company headquartered in Irvine, California. It sells branded apparel, accessories, and shoes. The company operates in the retail sector focusing on fashion products.

titan-machinery.name: Titan Machinery
titan-machinery.description: Titan Machinery, Inc. is a major dealer of agricultural and construction equipment based in West Fargo, North Dakota. It operates locations across the Midwestern United States, Australia, and several European countries. The company is known as the largest dealer for CNH Industrial brands worldwide.

titan-pharmaceuticals.name: Titan Pharmaceuticals
titan-pharmaceuticals.description: Titan Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It develops proprietary therapeutics mainly for central nervous system disorders. The company completed an IPO in 2018 and licenses intellectual property rights for its product Probuphine in Europe.

titan-tire-corporation.name: Titan Tire Corporation
titan-tire-corporation.description: The Titan Tire Corporation is an American manufacturer of off-road tires, founded in 1993. It expanded by acquiring assets from Pirelli Armstrong Tire Corporation and is one of the largest off-road tire producers in North America. It became a subsidiary of Titan International in 1997.

toagosei.name: Toagosei
toagosei.description: Toagosei Co., Ltd. is a Japanese chemical company known for producing cyanoacrylate adhesives since 1963. Its products include high purity gases, soda and chlorine products, and instant glue marketed as Aron Alpha in Japan and Krazy Glue in the United States.

tohoku-bank.name: Tohoku Bank
tohoku-bank.description: The Tohoku Bank Limited is a regional bank based in Morioka, Iwate prefecture, Japan. It operates in the Tohoku region and is considered one of the smallest regional banks in Japan.

toll-brothers.name: Toll Brothers
toll-brothers.description: Toll Brothers, Inc. is an American homebuilding company that constructs, markets, and finances residential and commercial properties across the United States. It was ranked as the fifth largest home builder in the U.S. by revenue in 2020 and is listed on the Fortune 500.

tonghua-grape-wine.name: Tonghua Grape Wine
tonghua-grape-wine.description: Tonghua Grape Wine Company, Limited is a Chinese winemaker based in Tonghua, Jilin Province. Established in 1937, the company employs around 1,200 people.

tongling-nonferrous-metals.name: Tongling Nonferrous Metals
tongling-nonferrous-metals.description: Tongling Nonferrous Metals Group Holding Company Limited is a state-owned Chinese enterprise specializing in copper extraction and smelting of copper and other non-ferrous metals. Founded in 1949 in Tongling, Anhui, it is one of China's largest copper smelting companies.

torrid.name: Torrid
torrid.description: Torrid Holdings Inc. is an American women's retail chain offering plus-size clothing and accessories for women size 10-30. It began operations in April 2001 and was formerly owned by Hot Topic, now owned by Sycamore Partners.

tourism-holdings-limited.name: Tourism Holdings Limited
tourism-holdings-limited.description: Tourism Holdings Limited is a New Zealand tourism company that started as a scenic helicopter sightseeing business called The Helicopter Line. It is now the world's largest provider of commercial RV rentals with operations in multiple countries and has been listed on the New Zealand Stock Exchange since 1986.

tower-bersama-infrastructure.name: Tower Bersama Infrastructure
tower-bersama-infrastructure.description: Tower Bersama Group is a telecommunications tower provider based in Indonesia.

townsquare-media.name: Townsquare Media
townsquare-media.description: Townsquare Media, Inc. is an American radio network and media company based in Purchase, New York. It expanded into digital media in the late 2000s and is the third-largest AM–FM operator in the US, owning 349 radio stations in 74 markets.

toyo-suisan.name: Toyo Suisan
toyo-suisan.description: Toyo Suisan Kaisha, Ltd., known as Toyo Suisan, is a Japanese company specializing in ramen noodles through its Maruchan brand, seafood, and frozen and refrigerated foods. It is the fourth-largest transnational seafood corporation.

toyobo.name: Toyobo
toyobo.description: Toyobo Co., Ltd. is one of Japan's top makers of fibers and textiles, producing synthetic fibers and natural fibers such as cotton and wool.

tracker-fund-of-hong-kong.name: Tracker Fund of Hong Kong
tracker-fund-of-hong-kong.description: Tracker Fund of Hong Kong (TraHK) is an index exchange-traded fund that provides investment results corresponding to the performance of the Hang Seng Index in the Hong Kong stock market.

transunion.name: TransUnion
transunion.description: TransUnion is an American consumer credit reporting agency based in Chicago, Illinois. It collects and aggregates information on over one billion consumers across more than thirty countries. It is one of the three largest credit agencies, alongside Experian and Equifax.

travelcenters-of-america.name: TravelCenters of America
travelcenters-of-america.description: TravelCenters of America LLC is a full-service truck stop and travel center company headquartered in Westlake, Ohio. It operates centers, convenience stores, and restaurants under several brands across 44 U.S. states. The company employs nearly 20,000 people as of 2021.

travelsky.name: TravelSky
travelsky.description: TravelSky Technology Limited is the dominant provider of IT services to the Chinese air travel and tourism industries. Its clients include airlines, airports, travel agencies, and cargo services. It is majority owned by the state-owned China TravelSky Holding Company and listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange.

travelzoo.name: Travelzoo
travelzoo.description: Travelzoo Inc. is an Internet company that publishes deals from over 2,000 travel, entertainment, and local businesses. It has 28 million members across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, and operates 25 offices worldwide.

tredegar-corporation.name: Tredegar corporation
tredegar-corporation.description: Tredegar Corporation is a publicly traded manufacturer of plastic films and aluminum extrusions headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. It was formed in 1989 from the spin-off of Ethyl Corporation's aluminium, plastics, and energy units. The energy assets were sold in 1994.

trevena-inc.name: Trevena Inc
trevena-inc.description: Trevena, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company based in Chesterbrook, Pennsylvania. Founded in 2007 with technology licensed from Duke University, it focuses on developing G-protein coupled receptor biased ligands. Its founders include Nobel Prize winner Robert Lefkowitz.

trinet-hr-services.name: TriNet HR Services
trinet-hr-services.description: TriNet Group, Inc. is a professional employer organization headquartered in Dublin, California. It provides payroll, health benefits administration, and employment law compliance services to small and medium-sized businesses. TriNet partners with organizations employing between 3 and 2,500 people.

trinity-industries.name: Trinity Industries
trinity-industries.description: Trinity Industries Inc. is an American industrial corporation that owns various businesses providing products and services to the industrial, energy, transportation, and construction sectors. It is based in the United States and operates as a conglomerate.

trulia.name: Trulia
trulia.description: Trulia is an American online real estate marketplace and a subsidiary of Zillow. It helps buyers and renters find homes and neighborhoods across the United States using recommendations, local insights, and map overlays with details on commute, schools, and nearby businesses.

trupanion.name: Trupanion
trupanion.description: Trupanion, Inc. is a pet insurance provider headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Founded in 1998, it operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, and Puerto Rico, offering coverage for pets and is self-underwritten by the American Pet Insurance Company.

trustco-bank.name: TrustCo Bank
trustco-bank.description: Trustco Bank is the sole subsidiary of Trustco Bank Corp NY, an American bank holding company based in Glenville, New York. Founded in 1902 in Schenectady, it operates 146 branches across New York, Florida, Massachusetts, New Jersey, and Vermont.

tsim-sha-tsui-properties-limited.name: Tsim Sha Tsui Properties Limited
tsim-sha-tsui-properties-limited.description: Tsim Sha Tsui Properties Limited is part of Sino Group, a Hong Kong-based conglomerate established in 1971. Sino Group includes three listed companies and private companies held by the Ng Family, operating in real estate.

tubemogul.name: TubeMogul
tubemogul.description: TubeMogul is an enterprise software company specializing in brand advertising. It is based in the United States and operates in the AI and software industry.

tuesday-morning.name: Tuesday Morning
tuesday-morning.description: Tuesday Morning Corporation is an American online household merchandise discount home goods store headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Founded in 1974, it once operated over 700 locations across the United States.

turtle-beach-systems.name: Turtle Beach Systems
turtle-beach-systems.description: Turtle Beach Corporation is an American gaming accessory manufacturer based in San Diego, California. Originating in the 1970s with sound cards and audio devices, it began producing gaming headsets in 2005.

tutor-perini.name: Tutor Perini
tutor-perini.description: Tutor Perini Corporation is one of the largest general contractors in the United States. Headquartered in Sylmar, California, it was formed by the merger of Perini Corporation and Tutor-Saliba Corporation in 2008. The company focuses on civil infrastructure, building infrastructure, and specialty contracting across North America and some international locations.

twilio.name: Twilio
twilio.description: Twilio Inc. is an American cloud communications and customer engagement company based in San Francisco, California. Founded in 2008, it provides programmable communication tools such as phone calls, text messaging, and conversational AI via web service APIs. Twilio has acquired companies including Authy and SendGrid since 2015.

twinbird-corporation.name: Twinbird Corporation
twinbird-corporation.description: Twinbird Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of household electric products founded in 1951. It is headquartered in Tsubame City, Niigata Prefecture, Japan. As of 2010, the company employed 284 people and was led by President Shigekatsu Nomizu.

tyro-payments.name: Tyro Payments
tyro-payments.description: Tyro Payments Limited is an Australian payments financial institution specializing in merchant credit, debit, and EFTPOS acquiring. It operates within the banking and fintech industry in Australia.

the-manitowoc-company.name: The Manitowoc Company
the-manitowoc-company.description: The Manitowoc Company, Inc. is an American manufacturer founded in 1902 that produces cranes. It designs, manufactures, markets, and supports various types of cranes under multiple brand names through its wholly owned subsidiaries.

tongrentang.name: Tongrentang
tongrentang.description: Tong Ren Tang is a Chinese pharmaceutical company founded in 1669 and headquartered in Beijing. It is the largest producer of traditional Chinese medicine and operates drug stores mainly in Chinese-speaking regions.

the-oriental-land-company.name: The Oriental Land Company
the-oriental-land-company.description: The Oriental Land Co., Ltd. is a Japanese leisure and tourism company headquartered in Urayasu, Chiba. It owns and operates the Tokyo Disney Resort and operates in theme parks, hotels, and other businesses. Its largest shareholder is Keisei Electric Railway.

toho.name: Toho
toho.description: Toho Co., Ltd. is a Japanese film production, distribution, and theater stage exhibition company headquartered in Chiyoda, Tokyo. It is known for producing and distributing many notable Japanese films and is the largest film importer in Japan through its subsidiaries.

tosoh.name: Tosoh
tosoh.description: Tosoh Corporation is a global chemical and specialty materials company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Founded in 1935 in Yamaguchi Prefecture as Toyo Soda Manufacturing Co., Ltd., it adopted its current name in 1987.

tivo-corporation.name: TiVo Corporation
tivo-corporation.description: TiVo Corporation, formerly Rovi Corporation and Macrovision Solutions Corporation, was an American technology company headquartered in San Jose, California. It licenses intellectual property in consumer electronics and provides analytics and recommendation platforms for the video industry.

toro.name: Toro
toro.description: The Toro Company is an American firm based in Bloomington, Minnesota. It designs, manufactures, and markets lawn mowers, snow blowers, and irrigation system supplies for commercial, residential, agricultural, and public sector uses.

terna-s-p-a.name: Terna S.p.A.
terna-s-p-a.description: Terna S.p.A. is a transmission system operator based in Rome, Italy. It manages around 98% of the Italian high-voltage power transmission grid and operates in Peru and the USA through Terna Plus. It is listed on the Borsa Italiana and part of the FTSE MIB index.

thk.name: THK
thk.description: THK Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company headquartered in Tokyo that provides machine elements and modules for mechanical engineering, robotics, and automation. Founded in April 1971, it has grown into an international company and has been listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's first segment since 2001.

toppan-holdings.name: Toppan Holdings
toppan-holdings.description: Toppan Holdings Inc. is a Japanese global printing company founded in 1900 and headquartered in Tokyo. It operates in the printing industry worldwide.

techint.name: Techint
techint.description: Techint is an Italian-Argentine conglomerate founded in 1945 by Agostino Rocca. It is headquartered in both Buenos Aires, Argentina, and Milan, Italy. The company operates in the metallurgy sector.

t-plus.name: T Plus
t-plus.description: T Plus is a Russian electricity generation company that is part of the Renova Group. It was formerly known as IES Holding until 2014. The company operates in the power engineering industry in Russia.

tampella.name: Tampella
tampella.description: Oy Tampella Ab was a Finnish heavy industry manufacturer based mainly in Tampere. It produced paper machines, locomotives, military weaponry, and wood-based products. The company operated in the arms industry.

tata-chemicals.name: Tata Chemicals
tata-chemicals.description: Tata Chemicals Limited is an Indian multinational corporation headquartered in Mumbai. It operates in chemicals, crop protection, and specialty chemistry products across India, Europe, North America, and Africa. The company is part of the Tata Group and has a publicly listed subsidiary called Rallis India.

te-data.name: TE Data
te-data.description: Telecom Egypt is Egypt's primary telephone company, founded in 1854 with the first telegraph line in the country. It is the first telecommunications company in Africa and replaced the Egyptian National Telecommunication Organization (ARENTO) in 1998.

telecom-namibia.name: Telecom Namibia
telecom-namibia.description: Telecom Namibia Limited is a telecommunications and ICT service provider operating in Namibia. Established in 1992, it is wholly government-owned and serves as the national telecommunications operator.

the-new-times.name: The New Times
the-new-times.description: The New Times is a national English-language newspaper in Rwanda established in 1995 shortly after the genocide against the Tutsi. It previously published a Kinyarwanda-language weekly called Izuba Rirashe. The newspaper serves as a key source of news in Rwanda.

telecitygroup.name: TelecityGroup
telecitygroup.description: Telecity Group plc was a European carrier-neutral data centre and colocation provider based in the United Kingdom. It specialized in designing, building, and managing datacentre space. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Equinix in January 2016.

tui-travel.name: TUI Travel
tui-travel.description: TUI Travel PLC was a British leisure travel group headquartered in Crawley, West Sussex. Formed in 2007 by merging First Choice Holidays and TUI AG's tourism division, it operated in 180 countries and served 30 million customers.

the-timberland-company.name: The Timberland Company
the-timberland-company.description: Timberland LLC is an American manufacturer and retailer of outdoor footwear and apparel, headquartered in Stratham, New Hampshire. The company also sells accessories such as watches, eyewear, and leather goods. It is owned by VF Corporation.

technip.name: Technip
technip.description: Technip S.A. was a French company specializing in project management, engineering, and construction for the energy industry. Headquartered in Paris, it merged with FMC Technologies in 2017 to form TechnipFMC and operated in 48 countries with about 38,000 employees.

taihan-cable-solution.name: Taihan Cable & Solution
taihan-cable-solution.description: Taihan Cable & Solution Co., Ltd. is a South Korean company that manufactures electric wires and stainless steel products for electricity and communication. Established in 1941 as South Korea's first wire and cable company, it is listed on the Korean Stock Exchange.

taylor-corporation.name: Taylor Corporation
taylor-corporation.description: Taylor Corporation is a privately owned print and communications company headquartered in North Mankato, Minnesota. Founded in 1975 by Glen Taylor, it operates in the communications sector. The company focuses on print and related services.

tempur-pedic.name: Tempur-Pedic
tempur-pedic.description: Tempur-Pedic International, Inc. manufactures and distributes mattresses and pillows made from viscoelastic foam. The company is headquartered in Lexington, Kentucky, with manufacturing plants in Virginia and New Mexico.

tradedoubler.name: Tradedoubler
tradedoubler.description: Tradedoubler is a global affiliate marketing network and provider of performance marketing and technology. Founded in Stockholm, Sweden, in 1999 by Felix Hagnö and Martin Lorentzon, it is led by president and CEO Matthias Stadelmeyer since 2014.

tsinghua-unigroup.name: Tsinghua Unigroup
tsinghua-unigroup.description: Tsinghua Unigroup Co., Ltd. is a state-owned Chinese technology and semiconductor manufacturer based in Beijing. It is among China's largest technology conglomerates, with subsidiaries including UNISOC, the country's largest mobile phone chip designer.

tsum.name: TsUM
tsum.description: TsUM — Central Universal Department Store is a high-end department store located in Moscow, Russia. It operates in the retail industry.

tnk-bp.name: TNK-BP
tnk-bp.description: TNK-BP was a major vertically integrated Russian oil company headquartered in Moscow. It was Russia's third-largest oil producer and among the ten largest private oil companies globally before being acquired by Rosneft in 2013.

topix.name: TOPIX
topix.description: The Tokyo Stock Price Index (TOPIX) is a major stock market index for the Tokyo Stock Exchange in Japan. It tracks most stocks in the Prime market and some in the Standard market, covering domestic companies.

tate-lyle.name: Tate & Lyle
tate-lyle.description: Tate & Lyle Plc is a British multinational supplier of food and beverage products to food and industrial markets. Originally a sugar refining business, it diversified from the 1970s and divested its sugar business in 2010.

travis-perkins.name: Travis Perkins
travis-perkins.description: Travis Perkins plc is a British builders' merchant and home improvement retailer headquartered in Northampton. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and operates in mainland Europe through its Toolstation subsidiary.

ted-baker-plc.name: Ted Baker Plc
ted-baker-plc.description: Ted Baker is a British clothing brand founded in 1988 in Glasgow, Scotland. The brand offers male and female clothing, accessories, aftershaves, and perfumes, and is styled as 'Ted Baker, London.' It operates in the consumer goods and retail sector.

tegra-incorporadora.name: Tegra Incorporadora
tegra-incorporadora.description: Tegra Incorporadora is a Brazilian real estate company and the fifth largest homebuilder in Brazil. It was founded in 2008 through the merger of three homebuilder companies and is a subsidiary of Canadian Brookfield Asset Management.

tectoy.name: Tectoy
tectoy.description: Tectoy is a Brazilian toy and electronics company headquartered in São Paulo. It is known for producing, publishing, and distributing Sega consoles and video games in Brazil. Founded in 1987, the company was established to develop the electronic toys and video games market in Brazil.

telecomunicacoes-de-sao-paulo.name: Telecomunicações de São Paulo
telecomunicacoes-de-sao-paulo.description: Telecomunicações de São Paulo S.A. (Telesp) was a telephony operator in the Brazilian state of São Paulo. It operated from 1973 until its privatization in 1998, when it was acquired by the Spanish company Telefónica. This acquisition led to the formation of Telefônica Brasil, which later adopted the Vivo brand for fixed-line operations.

telechips.name: Telechips
telechips.description: Telechips is a fabless semiconductor company based in Seoul, South Korea. Founded in 1999, it designs integrated circuits and maintains regional offices in Japan, China, the USA, Germany, and Singapore. The company operates in the electronic component industry.

tembec.name: Tembec
tembec.description: Tembec Industries Inc. was a Canadian paper company founded by Frank Dottori. It operated divisions in forest products, pulp, paper, paperboard, and chemicals with locations in Canada, the United States, and France. The company had approximately 3000 employees as of 2011.

torstar.name: Torstar
torstar.description: Torstar Corporation is a Canadian mass media company primarily publishing news. It is known for publishing the Toronto Star and also publishes daily newspapers in several Canadian regions. The company owns Metroland Media Group and holds a one-third ownership of the Canadian Press.

tc-transcontinental.name: TC Transcontinental
tc-transcontinental.description: Transcontinental Inc., operating as TC Transcontinental, is a Montreal-based company providing retail marketing services, commercial printing, and specialty media.

tourism-bank.name: Tourism Bank
tourism-bank.description: Tourism Bank is a private Iranian bank established in 2010 by Mehdi Jahangiri. It primarily focuses on supporting Iran’s tourism industry and offers a variety of financial services aimed at promoting and developing the country's tourism sector.

toei-animation.name: Toei Animation
toei-animation.description: Toei Animation Co., Ltd. is a Japanese animation studio controlled by Toei Company. It was originally founded on January 23, 1948, as Nihon Dōga by Kenzō Masaoka and Sanae Yamamoto. The company operates in the animation industry.

the-restaurant-group.name: The Restaurant Group
the-restaurant-group.description: The Restaurant Group plc is a British chain of restaurants and public houses, operating brands like Wagamama and Barburrito. It also runs pub restaurants and airport concessions and has been owned by US private equity company Apollo since 2023.

ti-group.name: TI Group
ti-group.description: TI Group plc was a holding company for specialized engineering companies based in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, United Kingdom. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange and was once part of the FTSE 100 Index.

tsys.name: TSYS
tsys.description: Total System Services, Inc. (TSYS) is an American financial technology company based in Columbus, Georgia. It provides payment processing, merchant services, prepaid debit cards, payroll cards, and demand deposit accounts to the underbanked.

taseko-mines.name: Taseko Mines
taseko-mines.description: Taseko Mines Limited is a mid-tier copper producer located in British Columbia, Canada. It operates the Gibraltar Mine, the second largest open-pit copper mine in Canada, and is planning several other mines including Prosperity, Harmony, and Aley.

tejarat-bank.name: Tejarat Bank
tejarat-bank.description: Bank Tejarat is a significant bank in Iran headquartered in Tehran. It was formed in 1979 by merging several institutions, including Bank Bazargani, the domestic successor of the Imperial Bank of Persia since 1952.

the-brick.name: The Brick
the-brick.description: The Brick Ltd. is a Canadian retailer of furniture, mattresses, appliances, and home electronics. Founded by the Comrie brothers in 1971, it opened its first warehouse in Edmonton, Alberta, and later expanded to other locations.

the-knot-worldwide.name: The Knot Worldwide
the-knot-worldwide.description: The Knot Worldwide is a technology company operating platforms and brands such as The Knot, WeddingWire, and WeddingPro. It was formed by a merger between The Knot and WeddingWire and provides marketplaces, content, and tools for wedding planning and life celebrations.

the-north-west-company.name: The North West Company
the-north-west-company.description: The North West Company Inc. is a Canadian multinational grocery and retail company. It operates stores in western Canada, northern territories, parts of the United States including Alaska and Hawaii, and other countries in Oceania and the Caribbean.

thoratec.name: Thoratec
thoratec.description: Thoratec Corporation was a U.S.-based company that developed and marketed medical devices for mechanical circulatory support, including ventricular assist devices for advanced heart failure patients. It specialized in healthcare technology for cardiac treatment.

tolypers.name: Tolypers
tolypers.description: Tolypers is an Iranian chemical and consumer goods company producing laundry detergent under the same brand name. Its products are sold in Iran and 17 other countries.

trican-well-service.name: Trican Well Service
trican-well-service.description: Trican Well Service Ltd. is a Canadian oilfield services provider headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. It offers services including acidizing, coiled tubing, fracturing, nitrogen pumping, and cementing. Its operations cover Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan.

tufin.name: Tufin
tufin.description: Tufin is a network security policy management company founded in 2005 with operations in the United States and internationally. In 2022, it was acquired by Turn/River Capital and became a private company.

tata-consumer-products.name: Tata Consumer Products
tata-consumer-products.description: Tata Consumer Products Limited is an Indian fast-moving consumer goods company and part of the Tata Group. Its registered office is in Kolkata and corporate headquarters in Mumbai. It is the world's second-largest manufacturer and distributor of tea and a major coffee producer.

trust-bank-limited.name: Trust Bank Limited
trust-bank-limited.description: Trust Bank PLC (Gambia), formerly Trust Bank Ltd, is a private commercial bank in the Gambia. It is one of twelve commercial banks licensed by the Central Bank of the Gambia, the national banking regulator.

tobruk-air.name: Tobruk Air
tobruk-air.description: Tobruk Air Transport and Cargo, commonly known as Tobruk Air, was a cargo airline based in Libya. No additional operational details are provided.

tiko-air.name: Tiko Air
tiko-air.description: Tiko Air is a charter airline based in Antananarivo, Madagascar. It operates charter flight services within Madagascar.

trustco-bank-namibia.name: Trustco Bank Namibia
trustco-bank-namibia.description: Trustco Bank Namibia Ltd., formerly FIDES Bank Namibia, was a commercial bank in Namibia owned by Trustco Group Holdings. Its primary activity was providing microfinancing services.

timidria.name: Timidria
timidria.description: Timidria is a human rights NGO in Niger founded by Ilguilas Weila. The organisation is dedicated to eradicating slavery in Niger. It operates as a non-governmental organisation focused on social issues.

tvc-news.name: TVC News
tvc-news.description: TVC News is a Nigerian 24-hour television news channel based in Lagos. It broadcasts on platforms including British Sky Broadcasting in the UK, DStv and Startimes in Nigeria, and Multi TV in Ghana.

turntable-certification-system-of-nigeri.name: TurnTable Certification System of Nigeria
turntable-certification-system-of-nigeri.description: TurnTable Certification System of Nigeria (TCSN) is a music recording certification body founded by the Nigerian music magazine TurnTable. It certifies albums and singles based on paid streams and digital downloads upon request.

tororo-cement-limited.name: Tororo Cement Limited
tororo-cement-limited.description: Tororo Cement Limited (TCL) is a Ugandan company and one of the largest manufacturers of construction materials in East Africa. It is based in Uganda and specializes in producing cement and related building materials.

telesom.name: Telesom
telesom.description: Telesom is a private telecommunications company founded in 2002 by local entrepreneurs in Hargeisa, Somaliland. It is the leading ICT service provider in the country, offering voice, mobile broadband, fixed broadband, SMS, mobile money, education, infotainment, and cloud services.

tarco-aviation.name: Tarco Aviation
tarco-aviation.description: Tarco Aviation is a private airline established in 2009 in Sudan. Initially based in Khartoum, it moved operations to Port Sudan due to the 2023 Sudanese civil war.

telkom-kenya.name: Telkom Kenya
telkom-kenya.description: Telkom Kenya is an integrated telecommunications provider based in Kenya. Established in April 1999 after the split of the Kenya Posts and Telecommunications Corporation, it is fully owned by the Government of Kenya as of 2023.

trans-nation-airways.name: Trans Nation Airways
trans-nation-airways.description: Trans Nation Airways is a charter airline based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Established in 2004, it is a subsidiary of the MIDROC Ethiopia Technology Group, owned by Sheikh Mohammed Hussein Al Amoudi.

tv3-ghana.name: TV3 Ghana
tv3-ghana.description: TV3 is a free-to-air television network based in Ghana, launched in 1997 by a Malaysian company. It produces and airs various television programs including dramas and reality shows. In 2011, it was acquired by Media General Ghana Limited.

total-petroleum-ghana.name: Total Petroleum Ghana
total-petroleum-ghana.description: TotalEnergies Marketing Ghana PLC, formerly Mobil Oil Ghana Limited, is a Ghanaian petroleum company. It operated 225 petrol stations across Ghana as of 2006 and held a significant market share. The company is listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange.

terra.name: Terra
terra.description: Terra was a Spanish Internet multinational company owned by Telefónica, headquartered in Spain with offices in multiple countries including Brazil and the US. Founded in 1999, it operated as a web portal and Internet access provider in Spain, the US, and Latin America before becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Telefónica in 2017.

tecnologia-automotiva-catarinense.name: Tecnologia Automotiva Catarinense
tecnologia-automotiva-catarinense.description: Tecnologia Automotiva Catarinense (TAC) is an automotive corporation established in 2004 in Joinville, Brazil. Supported by BNDES, it opened its plant in 2008 and developed the SUV TAC Stark in collaboration with Portuguese company Datasul.

teatro-oficina-uzyna-uzona.name: Teatro Oficina Uzyna Uzona
teatro-oficina-uzyna-uzona.description: Teatro Oficina Uzyna Uzona, commonly known as Teatro Oficina, is a theater company based in the Bixiga neighborhood of São Paulo, Brazil. Founded in 1958 at the University of São Paulo's Law School, it was established by Amir Haddad, José Celso Martinez Correa, Carlos Queiroz Telles, and Ron Daniels.

tv-bahia.name: TV Bahia
tv-bahia.description: TV Bahia is a television station in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil, affiliated with TV Globo. It is the flagship station of Rede Bahia de Televisão, a statewide network of six stations. TV Bahia's studios and transmitter are located in Salvador, and its signal reaches 133 cities in the state.

tv-oeste.name: TV Oeste
tv-oeste.description: TV Oeste is a television station licensed to Barreiras, Bahia, Brazil, affiliated with TV Globo. Owned by Rede Bahia, it is part of Rede Bahia de Televisão, a statewide network of six stations. TV Oeste's studios are in Barreiras, and its transmitter is located atop Serra da Bandeira.

tv-subae.name: TV Subaé
tv-subae.description: TV Subaé is a television station licensed to Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil, affiliated with TV Globo. Owned by Grupo Modesto Cerqueira and Rede Bahia, it is part of Rede Bahia de Televisão, a statewide network of six stations. Its studios and transmitter are located in the center of Feira de Santana.

tramontina.name: Tramontina
tramontina.description: Tramontina is a family-run metallurgical company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Carlos Barbosa, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. It operates in the metal goods industry.

transpetro.name: Transpetro
transpetro.description: Transpetro, officially Petrobras Transporte S.A., is the largest oil and gas transportation company in Brazil. It manages a network of over 11,000 kilometers of pipelines and operates a fleet of various tankers for oil, gas, and biofuels transportation.

tamar-project.name: TAMAR Project
tamar-project.description: The Projeto TAMAR is a Brazilian non-profit organization focused on protecting sea turtles from extinction along the Brazilian coastline. It is owned by the Chico Mendes Institute for Biodiversity Conservation and operates in the environmental sector.

tam-aviacao-executiva.name: TAM Aviação Executiva
tam-aviacao-executiva.description: TAM Aviação Executiva is a Brazilian airline specializing in air charter, aircraft sales, and maintenance. Founded in 1961 by Rolim Amaro, it remains owned by the Amaro family and is part of the TAM Group but not a subsidiary of TAM Airlines.

total-linhas-aereas.name: Total Linhas Aéreas
total-linhas-aereas.description: Total Linhas Aéreas is an airline based in Brasília, Brazil, founded in 1988. It operates cargo and charter services and is among the largest domestic cargo airlines in Brazil by market share.

tsogo-sun.name: Tsogo Sun
tsogo-sun.description: Tsogo Sun is a South African hotel, gambling, and entertainment group. It is half owned by Cape Town-based investment holding company Hosken Consolidated Investments. The company operates within the tourism industry in South Africa.

takealot-com.name: Takealot.com
takealot-com.description: Takealot is a South African e-commerce company founded in 2011. It is owned by the major mass media corporation Naspers. The company operates within the e-commerce sector in South Africa.

telediffusion-d-algerie.name: Télédiffusion d'Algérie
telediffusion-d-algerie.description: Algerian Broadcasting Company (Télédiffusion d'Algérie) is a public industrial and commercial company managing radio and television broadcasting services in Algeria. It also offers internet, technical, and satellite services under the supervision of Algeria's Ministry of Communications.

television-nacional-de-chile.name: Televisión Nacional de Chile
television-nacional-de-chile.description: Televisión Nacional de Chile (TVN) is a Chilean public service broadcaster founded by presidential order and launched nationwide in 1969. It operates under a public mission to promote national culture, democracy, human rights, and environmental care. TVN is governed by the National Television Council.

tvu.name: TVU
tvu.description: Televisión Universidad de Concepción (TVU) is a Chilean television channel broadcasting in Concepción on VHF channel 11. Its headquarters are located in the Universidad de Concepción in Chile.

telefe-rosario.name: Telefe Rosario
telefe-rosario.description: Telefe Rosario, known as Canal 5 de Rosario, is an Argentine television station broadcasting from Rosario, Santa Fe. It is owned by Grupo Televisión Litoral and serves Greater Rosario and northern Buenos Aires province. The station carries Telefe programming.

todo-noticias.name: Todo Noticias
todo-noticias.description: Todo Noticias is an Argentine pay and streaming news channel owned by the Clarín Group and Artear. It began broadcasting in 1993 and operates a news website ranked among the top in Argentina. It is the country's most watched news channel according to IBOPE.

tulio-crespi-s-a.name: Tulio Crespi S.A.
tulio-crespi-s-a.description: Tulio Crespi S.A. is an Argentine automobile manufacturer founded in 1962 by former racing driver Tulio Crespi. It has an industrial plant in Balcarce, Buenos Aires, producing automobiles and Formula racing vehicles. The company operates in the automotive industry.

transener.name: Transener
transener.description: Transener is an Argentine company specializing in the transmission of extra high voltage electric power. It is a leading firm in its sector within Argentina.

toyota-argentina.name: Toyota Argentina
toyota-argentina.description: Toyota Argentina S.A. is the Argentine subsidiary of the Japanese conglomerate Toyota and the first Japanese automotive company to produce in Argentina. Founded in 1994, it operates a manufacturing plant in Zárate, Buenos Aires, opened in 1997.

telefonica-argentina.name: Telefónica Argentina
telefonica-argentina.description: Telefónica Argentina is a telecommunications company based in Argentina. It is a subsidiary of Telefónica Group and was founded in 1990 following the privatization of the National Telecommunications Company (ENTel).

tandanor.name: Tandanor
tandanor.description: Tandanor is an Argentine shipyard located south of Buenos Aires port. Along with Almirante Storni yard, it forms CINAR, which is dedicated to shipbuilding and ship repair.

telecom-personal.name: Telecom Personal
telecom-personal.hq: Avenida Alicia Moreau de Justo, Argentina
telecom-personal.description: Telecom Personal is an Argentine telecommunications company providing Internet and mobile telephony services nationwide. It is a subsidiary of Telecom and since 2021 has combined broadband and mobile internet services under one brand. Personal is the second-largest mobile phone service provider in Argentina.

the-walt-disney-company-latin-america.name: The Walt Disney Company Latin America
the-walt-disney-company-latin-america.legal_name: The Walt Disney Company Latin America
the-walt-disney-company-latin-america.description: The Walt Disney Company Latin America is an international division of the Walt Disney Company. It manages the Disney brand and businesses throughout Latin America with offices in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, and Miami.

tregar.name: Tregar
tregar.description: García Hermanos Agroindustrial S.R.L., known as Tregar, is an Argentine dairy company headquartered in Gobernador Crespo, Santa Fe Province. Established in the 1940s, it remains family-owned and operates two production plants in Gobernador Crespo and Calchaquí.

turpial-airlines.name: Turpial Airlines
turpial-airlines.description: Turpial Airlines C.A. is a Venezuelan airline based at Arturo Michelena International Airport in Valencia. It operates a fleet of three Boeing 737-400 aircraft authorized for passenger, cargo, and mail flights both domestically and internationally.

the-women-s-development-bank.name: The Women's Development Bank
the-women-s-development-bank.description: The Women's Development Bank was established in Venezuela in 2001 to address political, economic, and social disadvantages faced by women. It provides small, low-interest loans and administrative training, offering both financial and non-financial services to women.

telesur.name: TeleSUR
telesur.description: Telesur is a Latin American terrestrial and satellite news television network headquartered in Caracas, Venezuela. It is sponsored by the governments of Venezuela, Cuba, and Nicaragua.

telesur-suriname.name: Telesur
telesur-suriname.description: Telesur is the government-owned telecommunications service provider in Suriname. It offers telephone, internet, and wireless services including CDMA, GSM, UMTS, HSPA+, and LTE networks. Telesur operates multiple frequency bands such as 900/1800 MHz GSM and 2100 MHz HSDPA.

trans-guyana-airways.name: Trans Guyana Airways
trans-guyana-airways.hq: Eugene F. Correia International Airport, Guyana
trans-guyana-airways.description: Trans Guyana Airways Limited is a Guyanese airline that began operations in 1956 in Georgetown with a single float airplane. It has since expanded its fleet to provide domestic and regional transportation, including service to remote areas of Guyana.

tia-sa.name: Tía SA
tia-sa.description: Tiendas Industriales Asociadas S.A., known as Tía, is a South American retail brand founded in 1940. Its divisions in Ecuador and Uruguay operate under several brands and are the largest discount retailers there. The Colombian Tía operations closed in 2017 due to poor sales.

terpel.name: Terpel
terpel.description: Terpel is a Colombian oil and gas company formerly known as Organización Terpel S.A. It operates in the petroleum industry within Colombia.

tobago-express.name: Tobago Express
tobago-express.description: Tobago Express was a scheduled passenger airline based in Trinidad and Tobago, operating as a sister airline to BWIA West Indies Airways. It provided service between Tobago's Arthur Napoleon Raymond Robinson International Airport and Trinidad's Piarco International Airport.

tigo-guatemala.name: Tigo Guatemala
tigo-guatemala.description: TIGO, Comunicaciones Celulares, S.A., also known as COMCEL, is a mobile phone service provider in Guatemala owned by the international company Millicom. In 2004, COMCEL rebranded to TIGO, introducing GSM technology, new phones, expanded coverage, and new plans.

tarek-nour-communications.name: Tarek Nour Communications
tarek-nour-communications.description: Tarek Nour Communications is a global marketing and communications company headquartered in Giza, Egypt. It is recognized as one of the largest advertising agencies in the Middle East.

telecorporacion-salvadorena.name: Telecorporación Salvadoreña
telecorporacion-salvadorena.description: Telecorporación Salvadoreña (TCS) is a television network corporation in El Salvador comprising channels 2, 4, 6, and SV+. It operates both analog and digital broadcasts and shares some programming across its channels, using the network name when linked together.

ticos-air.name: Ticos Air
ticos-air.description: Ticos Air was a planned Costa Rican airline that never commenced operations.

taag-angola-airlines.name: TAAG Angola Airlines
taag-angola-airlines.description: TAAG Angola Airlines E.P. is the state-owned flag carrier airline of Angola, based in Luanda. It operates domestic, medium-haul African, and long-haul international flights, using Dr. Antonio Agostinho Neto International Airport as its hub.

tanzania-broadcasting-corporation.name: Tanzania Broadcasting Corporation
tanzania-broadcasting-corporation.description: The Tanzanian Broadcasting Corporation is Tanzania's national television network. It is government-owned and operated.

tanga-cement.name: Tanga Cement
tanga-cement.description: Tanga Cement Public Limited Company is a cement manufacturer in Tanzania. Its shares are publicly listed on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange under the symbol TCCL.

tanzania-electric-supply-company-limited.name: Tanzania Electric Supply Company Limited
tanzania-electric-supply-company-limited.description: The Tanzania Electric Supply Company Limited (TANESCO) is a Tanzanian government-owned parastatal established in 1964. Its operations are regulated by the Ministry of Energy and Minerals.

tanzania-agricultural-development-bank.name: Tanzania Agricultural Development Bank
tanzania-agricultural-development-bank.description: The Tanzania Agricultural Development Bank (TADB) is a bank in Tanzania dedicated to farmers. The government has pledged $500 million as working capital for the bank.

tropical-air.name: Tropical Air
tropical-air.description: Tropical Air is an airline based in Zanzibar, Tanzania, founded in 1999 by Farouk Othman Daud. It was the first locally owned airline in Zanzibar and operates in Pemba, Dar es Salaam, and other Tanzanian areas.

togolese-red-cross.name: Togolese Red Cross
togolese-red-cross.description: Togolese Red Cross is an emergency and relief organization established in 1959. It is headquartered in Lomé, the capital city of Togo. The organization provides humanitarian aid and disaster relief services within the country.

television-togolaise.name: Télévision Togolaise
television-togolaise.description: Télévision Togolaise is the national broadcaster of Togo, based in the capital city, Lomé. It serves as the primary television service provider for the West African nation. The company operates within the communication industry.

tunisian-beverage-manufacturing-company.name: Tunisian Beverage Manufacturing Company
tunisian-beverage-manufacturing-company.description: The Tunisian Beverage Manufacturing Company, formerly known as the Tunis Frigorific and Brewery Company until 2012, is a Tunisian food industry group. It focuses on producing four main products within the agribusiness sector.

tunisie-telecom.name: Tunisie Telecom
tunisie-telecom.description: Tunisie Telecom is the incumbent telecom operator in Tunisia. It serves more than 6 million subscribers in fixed and mobile telephony both within Tunisia and abroad. The company is a key player in the Tunisian telecommunications industry.

tunisian-company-of-electricity-and-gas.name: Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas
tunisian-company-of-electricity-and-gas.legal_name: Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas
tunisian-company-of-electricity-and-gas.description: The Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas (STEG) is a Tunisian public company established in 1962. It is responsible for the production and distribution of electricity and natural gas throughout Tunisia. In 2009, STEG was the second-largest Tunisian company by revenues.

tunis-afrique-presse.name: Tunis Afrique Presse
tunis-afrique-presse.description: Tunis Afrique Presse (TAP) is a news agency based in Tunisia. It operates in the news media industry, providing news services within the country. TAP is a key source of news in Tunisia.

tunisian-national-oil-company.name: Tunisian National Oil Company
tunisian-national-oil-company.description: The Tunisian National Oil Company, known as ETAP, is a state-owned industrial and commercial company in Tunisia. It manages the petroleum sector and oversees the state's partnerships with foreign exploration and production operators. ETAP plays a central role in Tunisia's petroleum industry.

tunisian-red-crescent.name: Tunisian Red Crescent
tunisian-red-crescent.description: The Tunisian Red Crescent is a humanitarian association founded in 1956 after Tunisia's independence. It is a national affiliate of the International Movement of the Red Cross and Red Crescent. The organization was led by Brahim El Gharbi until 2018.

tunisian-confederation-of-industry-trade.name: Tunisian Confederation of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts
tunisian-confederation-of-industry-trade.legal_name: Tunisian Confederation of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts
tunisian-confederation-of-industry-trade.description: The Tunisian Confederation of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts (UTICA) is an employers' organization representing industrial, trade, and craft sectors in Tunisia. In 2015, UTICA was part of the National Dialogue Quartet awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for contributing to democracy after the Jasmine Revolution.

tunisair-express.name: Tunisair Express
tunisair-express.description: Tunisair Express is an airline based in Tunis, Tunisia, founded on August 1, 1991. It was formerly known as Tuninter and SevenAir and is a subsidiary of the national carrier Tunisair. The airline operates domestic flights within Tunisia and international services to Italy, France, and Malta.

tunisair.name: Tunisair
tunisair.description: Tunisair, officially La Société Tunisienne de l'Air, is the national airline of Tunisia, established in 1948. It operates scheduled international flights to four continents and is based at Tunis–Carthage International Airport. The airline's head office is located in Tunis near the airport.

tunisavia.name: Tunisavia
tunisavia.description: Tunisavia is a charter airline based in Tunis, Tunisia. Its main base of operations is Tunis-Carthage International Airport.

telcel.name: Telcel
telcel.description: Telcel, officially RadioMóvil Dipsa, S.A. de C.V., is a Mexican wireless telecommunications company owned by América Móvil. Founded in 1984 and based in Mexico City, it operates wireless networks across all nine geographic regions in Mexico using the 850 and 1900 megahertz radio spectrum.

tar-mexico.name: TAR México
tar-mexico.description: TAR México, legally Link Conexión Aérea, is a Mexican regional airline based in Querétaro. It operates scheduled flights to 12 national destinations using a fleet of Embraer ERJ 145 aircraft. The airline's main base is in Querétaro with additional focus cities.

trans-air-congo.name: Trans Air Congo
trans-air-congo.description: Trans Air Congo is an airline based at Pointe Noire Airport in Pointe-Noire, Republic of the Congo. The airline is banned from flying into European Union airspace.

trust-merchant-bank.name: Trust Merchant Bank
trust-merchant-bank.hq: Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo
trust-merchant-bank.description: Trust Merchant Bank (TMB) is a commercial bank based in Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Established in 2004, it operates across all local banking sectors including retail, SME, corporate, and mobile banking.
